attributes.description: Number of complimentary (comp) rooms included in the group block contract, typically awarded on a ratio basis (e.g., 1 comp per 40 paid rooms). Tracked separately for revenue accounting under USALI.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks; USALI; AHLA

attributes.name: contracted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the group block contract was formally executed and the block status moved to 'Definite'. Represents the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for the agreement lifecycle.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks; AHLA Group Contract Standards

attributes.name: contracted_rate_amount
attributes.description: Negotiated room rate per night per room agreed in the group block contract. Expressed in the property's operating currency. Confidential commercial term.
attributes.references: AHLA Group Contract Standards; USALI; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: contracted_room_nights
attributes.description: Total number of room nights committed in the group block contract across all room types and all nights of the block period. Primary quantitative measure of block size.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks; USALI

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the group block record was first created in the source system (OPERA PMS or Delphi). Serves as RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED for this entity.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; GDPR Article 5 (data accuracy); SOX

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values on this group block record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: cutoff_date
attributes.description: The contractual deadline by which individual reservations must be made against the block at the contracted group rate. Rooms not picked up by this date are released back to general inventory per the attrition policy.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks; AHLA Group Contract Standards

attributes.name: delphi_opportunity_reference
attributes.description: Source system identifier from Delphi by Amadeus event sales platform linking this group block to the originating sales opportunity or group proposal. Enables cross-system traceability.

attributes.name: departure_date
attributes.description: The last date of the contracted room block period — the date the group is scheduled to check out. Serves as EFFECTIVE_UNTIL for this agreement.

attributes.name: deposit_due_date
attributes.description: Contractual deadline by which the group deposit must be received to maintain the block in 'Definite' status.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; AHLA Group Contract Standards

attributes.name: deposit_received_amount
attributes.description: Actual deposit amount received from the group organizer to date. Compared against deposit_required_amount to determine outstanding deposit balance.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Cashiering; SAP S/4HANA Finance; USALI

attributes.name: deposit_required_amount
attributes.description: Contractual deposit amount required from the group to confirm the block. Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Cashiering; AHLA Group Contract Standards; USALI

attributes.name: group_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code used to identify the group block across systems (OPERA PMS, CRS, OTA channels). Used by guests and agents to associate individual reservations to the block. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this agreement.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the group (e.g., 'Smith Wedding Party', 'Acme Corp Q3 Sales Conference', 'Chicago Bulls Away Team'). Displayed on folios, rooming lists, and internal reports.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks; Delphi by Amadeus

attributes.name: group_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes and special instructions for the group block (e.g., VIP handling requirements, early check-in requests, amenity preferences, security arrangements). Sourced from OPERA PMS group block notes field.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the group travel party type. Drives billing rules, rate eligibility, and operational handling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tour|corporate|wedding|sports_team|airline_crew|government|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AHLA Group Business Standards; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the group block record in the source system. Serves as RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED for this entity. Used for incremental ETL processing.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; GDPR Article 5; SOX

attributes.name: opera_block_reference
attributes.description: Native block identifier from Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks module. Used for reconciliation and lineage tracing between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational source system.

attributes.name: peak_block_rooms
attributes.description: Maximum number of rooms blocked on any single night within the group block period. Used for capacity planning, displacement analysis, and revenue management evaluation.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS Group Evaluation

attributes.name: repeat_group_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this group has stayed at the property in a prior year or period. Used for loyalty recognition, preferential rate negotiation, and retention analytics.

attributes.name: rooming_list_due_date
attributes.description: Contractual deadline by which the group organizer must submit the complete rooming list with individual guest names and room type preferences.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks; AHLA Group Contract Standards

attributes.name: rooming_list_status
attributes.description: Current status of the rooming list submission for this group block. Tracks whether the group organizer has provided individual guest names and room assignments required for pre-arrival processing.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks; AHLA

attributes.name: rooms_picked_up
attributes.description: Current count of individual reservations made against the group block (actual pickup). Compared against contracted_room_nights to calculate pickup rate and attrition exposure.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks; revenue.pickup_report

attributes.name: suite_block_rooms
attributes.description: Number of suite-category rooms included in the contracted block. Tracked separately from standard rooms for inventory management and upsell reporting.

attributes.name: vip_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this group block has been designated as VIP, triggering elevated service protocols, dedicated concierge assignment, and executive-level attention.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Salesforce CRM; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: wash_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of contracted rooms expected to be released back to general inventory based on historical pickup patterns for this group type. Used by revenue management for net block sizing and forecasting.

products.name: vip_designation
products.description: VIP classification and designation records for high-value guests requiring elevated service protocols. Captures VIP level/tier (VIP1 through VIP5, Celebrity, Royalty, Owner, Board Member), designation reason (revenue threshold, corporate relationship, public figure status), assigned property host or butler, special handling instructions (amenity setup, GM greeting, airport transfer), amenity entitlements per tier, privacy flags (do-not-disturb, incognito check-in, no-photo policy), and designation validity period. One guest may hold multiple concurrent designations (e.g., VIP3 at brand level + Celebrity at property level). Sourced from OPERA PMS VIP codes and Salesforce CRM. Drives pre-arrival preparation checklists, room assignment priority, upgrade eligibility, and service recovery escalation paths.

attributes.name: vip_designation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each VIP designation record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the vip_designation data product. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS VIP code assignments and Salesforce CRM VIP profile records.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profile Module

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corporate account record when the VIP designation is granted based on a corporate relationship (e.g., key account executive, contracted corporate partner). Null for individual leisure VIP guests. Sourced from Salesforce CRM account object.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; Oracle OPERA PMS Company Profile

attributes.name: loyalty_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program membership record associated with this VIP guest. Links VIP designation entitlements with loyalty tier benefits to ensure non-duplication and correct benefit stacking. Sourced from Salesforce CRM loyalty management module.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Management; AHLA Loyalty Program Standards

attributes.name: preferred_room_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.room_type. Business justification: VIP designation drives room assignment priority and upgrade eligibility to specific room types. Pre-arrival VIP checklists and front-desk upgrade workflows require knowing which room type a VIP is ent

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest profile record for whom this VIP designation is assigned. Links to the master guest profile in the guest domain. A single guest may hold multiple concurrent VIP designations across brand and property levels.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profile Module; Salesforce CRM Guest Object

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property at which this VIP designation applies. A designation may be property-specific (e.g., Celebrity at a single resort) or brand-wide (null indicates brand-level designation). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS property configuration.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Property Configuration; AHLA Property Standards

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier. Business justification: VIP designation rules are tier-dependent: only Platinum members receive GM greeting, security escort, or incognito check-in. Operations and loyalty teams need to know which tier threshold governs or t

attributes.name: airport_transfer_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a complimentary or arranged airport transfer service is required for this VIP guest as part of their designation entitlements. Triggers coordination with the concierge and transportation team during pre-arrival preparation.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Pre-Arrival Checklist; AHLA Concierge Service Standards

attributes.name: alias_name
attributes.description: Pseudonym or alias name used for incognito check-in and reservation bookings to protect the identity of high-profile guests. Used in place of the guest's legal name on folios, room assignments, and staff communications when incognito_checkin is true.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; CCPA Section 1798.100; Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profile Privacy Fields

attributes.name: amenity_tier_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the amenity entitlement package associated with this VIP level. Determines the standard amenity setup (e.g., welcome fruit basket, champagne, floral arrangement, personalized stationery) to be prepared prior to guest arrival. Sourced from OPERA PMS amenity configuration.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Amenity Configuration; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: concurrent_designation_count
attributes.description: Number of active VIP designations currently held by this guest across all scopes (brand and property level). Supports operational awareness that a guest may hold multiple concurrent designations (e.g., VIP3 at brand level and Celebrity at property level) and ensures all applicable protocols are honored.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Table; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VIP designation record was first created in the silver layer lakehouse. Represents the audit trail creation event. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per platform conventions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (data accountability); SOX Section 404 (audit trail); ISO 27001

attributes.name: designation_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code identifying this VIP designation record, as assigned in Oracle OPERA PMS VIP code table (e.g., VIP1, VIP3, CELEB, ROYAL, OWNER). Used for cross-system reference and pre-arrival checklist triggers.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Table; HTNG Guest Profile Standards

attributes.name: designation_notes
attributes.description: Internal narrative notes providing additional context about the VIP designation, such as the relationship history, specific events that triggered the designation, or instructions for the guest relations team. Visible only to authorized staff. Sourced from Salesforce CRM case notes.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Management; GDPR Article 5; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: designation_reason
attributes.description: Business rationale for granting the VIP designation. Revenue threshold indicates the guest meets a minimum annual spend threshold. Corporate relationship indicates a key account or contracted corporate partner. Public figure, diplomatic, and celebrity reasons trigger additional privacy protocols. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: revenue_threshold|corporate_relationship|public_figure|loyalty_elite|owner|board_member|celebrity|diplomatic|media|government — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM VIP Classification; AHLA Guest Experience Standards; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: designation_scope
attributes.description: Indicates whether the VIP designation applies across the entire brand portfolio, is restricted to a specific property, or applies to a regional cluster of properties. Drives which properties must honor the designation during pre-arrival preparation.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Table; HTNG Guest Profile Standards

attributes.name: designation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the VIP designation record. Active designations drive pre-arrival checklists and upgrade eligibility. Suspended designations are temporarily paused. Revoked designations have been withdrawn due to policy violation or relationship change.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Table; Salesforce CRM VIP Status Field

attributes.name: do_not_disturb
attributes.description: Indicates that the guest has a standing do-not-disturb preference that must be honored by housekeeping, engineering, and all operational departments unless a safety emergency arises. Overrides standard housekeeping scheduling in Oracle OPERA PMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Housekeeping Configuration; OSHA Safety Standards

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the VIP designation becomes active and service protocols are triggered. Used to schedule pre-arrival preparation and amenity entitlements. Aligns with OPERA PMS VIP code validity start date.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Validity; HTNG Guest Profile Standards

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the VIP designation expires and service protocols are deactivated. Null indicates an open-ended designation with no planned expiry. Annual review cycles typically reset this date. Aligns with OPERA PMS VIP code validity end date.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Validity; HTNG Guest Profile Standards

attributes.name: gm_greeting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the General Manager (GM) or designated senior property leader is required to personally greet this VIP guest upon arrival. Triggers a GM greeting task in the pre-arrival preparation checklist within Oracle OPERA PMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Pre-Arrival Checklist; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: incognito_checkin
attributes.description: Indicates that the guest requires a discreet, incognito check-in process to protect their identity and privacy. When true, the front desk must use a private check-in area, suppress the guest name from public-facing displays, and limit staff awareness of the guest's presence. Critical for celebrity and diplomatic guests.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Privacy Flags; GDPR Article 5; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: last_stay_date
attributes.description: Date of the guest's most recent completed stay at any property under this VIP designation's scope. Used during annual VIP review cycles to assess continued eligibility based on recency of engagement. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS reservation history.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Reservation History; AHLA Guest Loyalty Standards

attributes.name: media_blackout
attributes.description: Indicates that all media inquiries, press requests, and social media references related to this guest's stay must be suppressed and escalated to the Director of Communications. Distinct from no_photo_policy as it governs external communications rather than on-property photography.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; CCPA Section 1798.100; AHLA Communications Standards

attributes.name: no_photo_policy
attributes.description: Indicates that the guest has explicitly prohibited photography, video recording, or any visual documentation of their presence on property. Staff must be briefed on this restriction during pre-arrival preparation. Applies to celebrity, royalty, and diplomatic designations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; CCPA Section 1798.100; AHLA Guest Privacy Standards

attributes.name: pre_arrival_checklist_template
attributes.description: Code identifying the standardized pre-arrival preparation checklist template to be activated for this VIP designation. Templates define the sequence of tasks (amenity setup, room inspection, GM briefing, transportation coordination) required before the guest's arrival.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Pre-Arrival Task Management; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: revenue_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum annual revenue contribution (in USD) that qualified this guest for the VIP designation based on the revenue threshold reason. Used for annual VIP eligibility reviews and LTV (Lifetime Value) analysis. Sourced from OPERA PMS revenue history and SAP S/4HANA financial records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance GL; USALI Revenue Classification; AHLA Revenue Standards

attributes.name: revenue_threshold_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the revenue_threshold_amount field. Ensures correct currency context for multi-currency properties and international guests. Defaults to USD for US-based properties.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA Multi-Currency Configuration

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this VIP designation to confirm continued eligibility based on revenue thresholds, relationship status, or public figure standing. Supports annual VIP audit processes managed by the guest relations team.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM VIP Review Workflow; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why a VIP designation was revoked or suspended. Populated only when designation_status is revoked or suspended. Supports audit trail requirements and VIP eligibility governance reviews. Sourced from Salesforce CRM case closure reason.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Management; SOX Internal Controls; AHLA Guest Relations Governance

attributes.name: room_assignment_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank (lower value = higher priority) used by the front desk and revenue management systems to sequence room assignment and upgrade eligibility for this VIP guest relative to other arriving guests. Integrates with IDeaS G3 RMS inventory controls.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Room Assignment; IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls

attributes.name: security_escort_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a dedicated security escort or personal protection detail coordination is required for this VIP guest during their stay. Triggers security briefing and coordination protocols with the property security team and any external protection services.
attributes.references: AHLA Safety and Security Standards; OSHA Workplace Safety

attributes.name: service_recovery_escalation_level
attributes.description: Defines the escalation path and response urgency for service recovery incidents involving this VIP guest. Immediate_gm requires the General Manager to be notified within minutes of any complaint. Drives Medallia case routing and Salesforce CRM service recovery workflows.
attributes.references: Medallia Service Recovery Module; Salesforce CRM Case Management; AHLA Guest Satisfaction Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this VIP designation record originated. OPERA_PMS indicates the designation was created in Oracle OPERA PMS. SALESFORCE_CRM indicates origination from Salesforce CRM. MANUAL indicates a direct data entry by the data team. MIGRATION indicates a historical data load.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Salesforce CRM; HTNG Data Exchange Standards

attributes.name: source_system_vip_code
attributes.description: The native VIP code or identifier as stored in the originating source system (Oracle OPERA PMS or Salesforce CRM). Retained for traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Table; Salesforce CRM VIP Field; HTNG Data Exchange Standards

attributes.name: special_handling_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing bespoke service instructions specific to this VIP designation, such as preferred room temperature, dietary restrictions for amenity setup, security escort requirements, or specific staff interaction protocols. Sourced from Salesforce CRM case notes and OPERA PMS profile remarks.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Profile Remarks; Salesforce CRM Case Management; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: total_stays_in_period
attributes.description: Count of completed stays by the guest within the current designation validity period (effective_from to effective_until). Used to validate continued VIP eligibility at review date and to support LTV (Lifetime Value) reporting. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS stay history.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Stay History; USALI Guest Statistics; AHLA Loyalty Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this VIP designation record in the silver layer lakehouse. Tracks changes to designation status, special handling instructions, privacy flags, or host assignments. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per platform conventions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (data accountability); SOX Section 404 (audit trail); ISO 27001

attributes.name: upgrade_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this VIP designation entitles the guest to complimentary room category upgrades subject to availability at check-in. When true, the front desk system surfaces upgrade options during the check-in workflow in Oracle OPERA PMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Upgrade Rules; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: vip_level
attributes.description: Tiered classification of the VIP designation indicating the service protocol level assigned to the guest. VIP1 is entry-level recognition; VIP5 is the highest standard tier. Celebrity, Royalty, Owner, and Board Member are special-class designations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VIP1|VIP2|VIP3|VIP4|VIP5|Celebrity|Royalty|Owner|Board Member — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Table; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

products.name: stay_history
products.description: Consolidated historical record of all completed guest stays across all properties and brands. Captures arrival date, departure date, property, room type, room number, rate plan, ADR, total revenue (rooms + F&B + ancillary), LOS, number of guests, booking channel, and stay outcome (completed, early departure, extended). Sourced from OPERA PMS post-checkout records. Foundational for LTV calculation, segmentation, and personalization. Distinct from active reservations managed in the reservation domain.

attributes.name: stay_history_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each completed guest stay record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the stay_history data product. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS post-checkout records.

attributes.name: booking_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.booking_source. Business justification: Channel attribution reporting and commission reconciliation require linking each stay to its originating booking_source. Revenue managers and finance teams run source-of-business reports at stay level

attributes.name: campaign_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign_offer. Business justification: A stay booked under a promotional campaign offer must reference that offer for offer performance measurement, incremental revenue attribution, and loyalty points multiplier application. rate_plan_code

attributes.name: corporate_account_id

attributes.description: Timestamp when this consent record was first created in the data platform. Part of standard audit trail for data lineage and compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: crm_consent_reference
attributes.description: The unique consent record identifier from the source CRM system (Salesforce). Used for traceability and reconciliation with the operational system of record.

attributes.name: double_opt_in_confirmed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the guest confirmed their consent via double opt-in mechanism (e.g., clicked email confirmation link). Null if double opt-in was not used or not yet confirmed.

attributes.name: double_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consent was confirmed through a double opt-in process (e.g., email confirmation link). True if double opt-in was completed, False otherwise. Best practice for email marketing consent.
attributes.references: CASL (Canada Anti-Spam Legislation); Email Marketing Best Practices

attributes.name: guest_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the guest primary country of residence at the time consent was captured. Used to determine applicable privacy regulations.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address from which the consent was submitted. Used as part of the audit trail to demonstrate consent authenticity. May be considered PII in some jurisdictions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4(1) - IP as Personal Data; CCPA

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The primary privacy regulation or jurisdiction governing this consent record. Examples include GDPR (EU), CCPA (California), CASL (Canada), LGPD (Brazil), PIPEDA (Canada federal), APPI (Japan), POPIA (South Africa). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GDPR|CCPA|CASL|LGPD|PIPEDA|APPI|POPIA — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GDPR (EU); CCPA (California); CASL (Canada); LGPD (Brazil); PIPEDA (Canada); APPI (Japan); POPIA (South Africa)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this consent record was last updated in the data platform. Tracks the most recent change for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: legal_basis
attributes.description: The lawful basis under GDPR Article 6 for processing the guest personal data for this communication purpose. Options include consent, legitimate interest, contract fulfillment, legal obligation, vital interest, or public task.

attributes.name: marketing_cloud_subscriber_key
attributes.description: The subscriber key from Salesforce Marketing Cloud or equivalent marketing automation platform. Links consent records to email marketing subscriber profiles for suppression list management.

attributes.name: profiling_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest has consented to automated profiling and decision-making for personalized marketing and offers. Required under GDPR Article 22.

attributes.name: record_active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent record is currently active and should be used for consent enforcement. False if the record has been superseded or logically deleted.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system from which this consent record originated. Examples include Salesforce CRM, OPERA PMS, mobile app, web portal, call center system, or front desk system.

attributes.name: suppression_list_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this guest and communication type combination is currently on the suppression list (opted out or consent withdrawn). True if suppressed, False if active consent.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; CASL; Email Marketing Best Practices

attributes.name: third_party_sharing_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest has consented to sharing their personal data with third-party partners (e.g., OTA partners, co-branded loyalty programs). True if consented, False otherwise.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; CCPA Section 1798.115 - Right to Know About Disclosures

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: The browser or application user agent string captured at the time of consent submission. Provides additional context for consent authenticity verification.

products.name: identity_document
products.description: Guest identity document records capturing passport, national ID, driver's license, and visa details required for check-in compliance and international travel regulations. Captures document type, document number, issuing country, issue date, expiry date, scan/image reference, and verification status. Sourced from OPERA PMS check-in capture. Required for AML compliance, international property operations, and government reporting in applicable jurisdictions.

attributes.name: identity_document_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the guest identity document record. Primary key for the identity document entity.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest profile who owns this identity document. Links to the guest master record in the guest domain.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property where this identity document was captured or verified during check-in. Links to property master data.

attributes.name: reservation_booking_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reservation during which this identity document was captured. May be null for documents captured outside of a specific reservation context.

attributes.name: capture_channel
attributes.description: Channel or touchpoint through which the identity document was captured. Values: front_desk (traditional check-in), mobile_checkin (mobile app), kiosk (self-service kiosk), online_precheckin (web portal), concierge (concierge desk).

attributes.name: capture_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the identity document information was first captured into the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Represents the business event time of document capture.

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this document record meets all regulatory compliance requirements for the jurisdiction. True if compliant, False if additional documentation or verification is required.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this identity document record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Audit trail field for record creation.

attributes.name: data_retention_category
attributes.description: Data retention classification for this identity document record. Determines how long the record must be retained per regulatory and business requirements. Values: standard (normal retention period), extended (longer retention for compliance), legal_hold (litigation hold), purge_eligible (eligible for deletion).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Storage Limitation), CCPA, Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Guest date of birth as recorded on the identity document. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. Used for age verification and compliance.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The unique identification number printed on the identity document. This is the primary identifier on the document itself (e.g., passport number, national ID number, drivers license number).

attributes.name: document_scan_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the scanned image or digital copy of the identity document stored in the document management system. Used for audit and compliance verification.
attributes.references: PCI DSS, GDPR Article 32 (Security of Processing)

attributes.name: document_scan_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the identity document was scanned or digitally captured. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type of identity document presented by the guest. Standard types include passport, national ID card, drivers license, visa, residence permit, and military ID.
attributes.references: ICAO Document 9303 (Machine Readable Travel Documents), AML/KYC Standards

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the identity document expires and is no longer valid for identification purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. Null for documents with no expiration.

attributes.name: full_name_on_document
attributes.description: Complete legal name as printed on the identity document. Used for verification and compliance purposes to match against guest profile name.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Consent Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the guest has provided explicit consent for the collection and processing of their identity document data under GDPR. True if consent obtained, False otherwise.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawfulness of Processing), GDPR Article 7 (Conditions for Consent)

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Gender marker as recorded on the identity document. Values: M (Male), F (Female), X (Unspecified/Non-binary), U (Unknown/Not stated).

attributes.name: government_report_status
attributes.description: Status of government reporting submission for this identity document. Values: not_required (no reporting obligation), pending (awaiting submission), submitted (sent to authorities), confirmed (acknowledged by authorities), failed (submission error).

attributes.name: government_report_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the identity document information was reported to government authorities. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Null if not yet reported or not required.

attributes.name: government_reporting_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this identity document record must be reported to government authorities per local regulations (e.g., police registration, immigration reporting). True if reporting is required, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Local Government Reporting Requirements, Immigration Law

attributes.name: is_primary_document
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the primary identity document on file for the guest. True if this is the main document used for identification, False otherwise.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the identity document was issued by the issuing authority. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the government agency or authority that issued the identity document (e.g., U.S. Department of State, UK Home Office, Ministry of Interior).

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country or jurisdiction that issued the identity document.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this identity document record was last updated or modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Audit trail field for record modification.

attributes.name: nationality_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the guests nationality as stated on the identity document.

attributes.name: place_of_birth
attributes.description: City and country of birth as recorded on the identity document. Used for enhanced identity verification in some jurisdictions.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the authenticity of the identity document. Values: manual (staff visual inspection), automated (OCR/document scanner), biometric (facial recognition or fingerprint match), third_party (external verification service).

attributes.name: verification_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes recorded by staff during the verification process. May include observations about document condition, discrepancies, or reasons for rejection.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current verification status of the identity document. Indicates whether the document has been validated by staff or automated systems. Values: pending (awaiting verification), verified (validated and accepted), rejected (invalid or fraudulent), expired (document past expiry date), flagged (requires additional review).

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the identity document verification was completed. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: visa_entry_type
attributes.description: Entry type permitted by the visa. Values: single (one entry only), multiple (multiple entries allowed), transit (transit visa). Null for non-visa documents.

attributes.name: visa_type
attributes.description: Type or category of visa if the document is a visa (e.g., tourist, business, student, work). Null for non-visa documents.

products.name: segment
products.description: Guest market segmentation master definitions and individual guest-to-segment assignment records. The master component defines business segments (transient, group, contract, wholesale, complimentary, crew) with segment code, name, hierarchy level, USALI mapping, and applicable rate strategy. The assignment component tracks individual guest-to-segment associations including assignment date, assignment method (rule-based, ML-inferred, manual override), confidence score, validity period, and superseding assignment reference. Sourced from OPERA PMS Market Segment codes, IDeaS G3 RMS, and Salesforce CRM segmentation. Used for RevPAR analysis, demand forecasting, targeted marketing, rate fence enforcement, and LTV-based prioritization. Note: this product contains both reference definitions and transactional assignments — the master definitions change infrequently while assignments are high-volume.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the guest market segment record. Primary key for both segment master definitions and individual guest-to-segment assignment records.

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.cancellation_policy. The existing cancellation_p

attributes.name: marketing_guest_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.guest_segment. Business justification: Properties cross-reference booking market segments (transient, group, contract) with marketing behavioral segments (high-value leisure, business road warrior) for campaign eligibility rules, personali

attributes.name: parent_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent segment in the hierarchy for roll-up aggregation. Null for top-level segments.

attributes.name: primary_superseded_by_assignment_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the segment assignment record that supersedes this one. Used for tracking segment migration history and maintaining assignment lineage.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual guest profile for guest-to-segment assignment records. Null for segment master definition records.
attributes.references: OPERA PMS Guest Profile, Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.property. Business justification: Property-level guest segmentation is a core revenue management process: segments defined at a specific property (vs. chain-wide) drive rate strategy, displacement analysis, and RevPAR reporting. Reven

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier. Business justification: Guest segments are mapped to loyalty tier eligibility rules for rate strategy and yield management. Revenue management systems join segment to tier to apply correct points multipliers, determine LRA e

attributes.name: adr_index_vs_property
attributes.business_glossary_term: ADR (Average Daily Rate) Index vs Property
attributes.description: Average Daily Rate index for this segment relative to property-wide ADR. 1.0 = at property average, >1.0 = premium segment, <1.0 = discount segment. Used for segment mix optimization.

attributes.name: advance_booking_window_days
attributes.description: Typical advance booking window in days for this segment. Used for demand forecasting and pickup analysis. Transient segments typically 0-30 days, Group segments 90-365 days.

attributes.name: ancillary_revenue_per_stay
attributes.description: Average ancillary revenue (F&B, spa, parking, resort fees, etc.) per stay for this segment. Used for total revenue forecasting and TRevPAR optimization.

attributes.name: assignment_confidence_score
attributes.description: Confidence score (0.000 to 1.000) for ML-inferred segment assignments. Higher scores indicate greater model certainty. Null for rule-based and manual assignments.

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: Date when the guest was assigned to this segment. Used for tracking segment migration and guest lifecycle analysis.

attributes.name: assignment_effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this segment assignment is effective for the guest. Used for time-bound segment membership (e.g., corporate contract validity period).

attributes.name: assignment_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment assignment expires for the guest. Null for indefinite assignments. Used for contract-based and time-limited segment memberships.

attributes.name: assignment_method
attributes.description: Method used to assign the guest to this segment. Rule-based uses business rules (e.g., booking channel, rate code), ML-inferred uses machine learning models for predictive segmentation, Manual-override represents analyst or sales manager assignment, Reservation-based inherits from reservation market segment code.

attributes.name: assignment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes explaining the rationale for manual segment assignments or overrides. Used for audit trail and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: assignment_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the business reason for this segment assignment (e.g., CORP_CONTRACT, BOOKING_CHANNEL, STAY_PATTERN, SALES_OVERRIDE, LTV_TIER). Used for assignment audit and quality control.

attributes.name: average_los_days
attributes.description: Historical average Length of Stay in days for guests in this segment. Used for demand forecasting and inventory optimization.

attributes.name: commission_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether bookings in this segment are eligible for travel agent or OTA commission payments.

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: Standard commission percentage paid to intermediaries for bookings in this segment. Null if commission_eligible is False.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this segment record was first created in the lakehouse. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: displacement_analysis_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether group bookings in this segment should undergo displacement analysis to compare group revenue against potential transient revenue. Used for group evaluation and acceptance decisions.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment definition was retired or superseded. Null for currently active segments.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment definition became effective. Used for historical segment analysis and time-travel queries.

attributes.name: fb_attachment_rate_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: F&B (Food and Beverage) Attachment Rate Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of guests in this segment who purchase F&B services during their stay. Used for TRevPAR analysis and ancillary revenue forecasting.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the segment hierarchy for roll-up reporting. Level 1 is top-level (e.g., Transient), Level 2 is sub-segment (e.g., Qualified Corporate), Level 3 is micro-segment (e.g., Tech Industry Corporate).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this segment record was last updated. Used for change tracking and incremental processing.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether stays booked under this segment earn loyalty program points and elite night credits.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base points earning for this segment. Standard is 1.0, promotional segments may have higher multipliers (e.g., 1.5x, 2.0x).

attributes.name: lra_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment has Last Room Availability commitment, meaning inventory is available at the contracted rate even when the property is sold out. Typically True for top-tier corporate contracts and loyalty elite members.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or system identifier of the user or process that last modified this record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: rate_strategy_type
attributes.description: Pricing strategy applicable to this segment. Dynamic uses RMS (Revenue Management System) optimization, Fixed uses BAR (Best Available Rate) or published rates, Negotiated uses contracted rates, Promotional uses discount codes, Opaque uses non-branded OTA channels.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Rate Strategy Framework

attributes.name: revpar_contribution_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: RevPAR (Revenue Per Available Room) Contribution Percentage
attributes.description: Historical percentage contribution of this segment to total property RevPAR. Sum across all segments equals 100%. Used for strategic segment mix planning.

attributes.name: segment_category
attributes.description: Broader business category for revenue and demand analysis. Used for RevPAR (Revenue Per Available Room) decomposition and TRevPAR (Total Revenue Per Available Room) attribution.

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code identifying the market segment (e.g., TRANS, GRP, CORP, WHSL, COMP, CREW). Sourced from OPERA PMS Market Segment codes and IDeaS G3 RMS segment taxonomy.
attributes.references: OPERA PMS Market Segment Standards, USALI

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the market segment (e.g., Transient, Group, Corporate Negotiated, Wholesale, Complimentary, Airline Crew).

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the segment definition. Active segments are available for assignment and reporting, Inactive segments are hidden from selection but retained for historical analysis, Deprecated segments are being phased out, Pending segments are awaiting approval.

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the segment type. Transient represents FIT (Free Independent Traveler) guests, Group represents MICE (Meetings Incentives Conferences Exhibitions) and leisure groups, Contract represents negotiated corporate accounts, Wholesale represents OTA (Online Travel Agency) and tour operator bookings, Complimentary represents comp stays and employee rates, Crew represents airline and travel industry staff.
attributes.references: USALI, STR (Smith Travel Research) Segment Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System of record that originated this segment definition or assignment. OPERA for PMS market segments, IDEAS for RMS segments, SALESFORCE for CRM segmentation, MANUAL for analyst-created segments.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this segment in the source system. Used for data reconciliation and lineage tracking.

attributes.name: usali_mapping_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) Mapping Code
attributes.description: Standard USALI account code for financial reporting and GOP (Gross Operating Profit) attribution. Ensures consistent revenue classification across properties.

attributes.name: yield_management_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment is subject to dynamic yield optimization and inventory controls by the RMS. True for transient and qualified segments, False for contracted and complimentary segments.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS, Revenue Management Best Practices

products.name: relationship
products.description: Guest-to-guest relationship records capturing known associations between guest profiles for household-level service personalization and corporate travel program management. Captures relationship type (spouse/partner, parent/child, executive assistant, corporate booker-to-traveler, travel companion), relationship direction (bidirectional or unidirectional), start date, end date, primary contact designation, and shared preference inheritance flag. Enables family recognition programs (e.g., greeting children by name), household-level LTV aggregation, assistant-mediated booking attribution, and corporate travel coordinator visibility. Sourced from Salesforce CRM relationship objects and front desk manual entry.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the guest-to-guest relationship record. Primary key.

attributes.name: corporate_account_id

attributes.name: direction

attributes.name: emergency_contact_flag

attributes.name: end_date

attributes.name: gdpr_lawful_basis

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: primary_contact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the related guest is the primary contact for the primary guest. Used for assistant-mediated booking attribution and corporate travel coordinator visibility.

attributes.name: priority

attributes.name: relationship_status

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Type of relationship between the two guests. Defines the nature of the association (e.g., spouse/partner, parent/child, executive assistant, corporate booker-to-traveler, travel companion).

attributes.name: shared_preference_inheritance_flag

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this relationship record in the source system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: start_date

attributes.name: verified_date

attributes.name: verified_flag

domains.name: reservation

products.name: cancellation
products.description: Transactional record capturing all reservation non-fulfillment events including guest cancellations, property-initiated cancellations, OTA-initiated cancellations, and no-show (non-arrival) events. For cancellations: records event date/time, reason code, applicable cancellation policy, penalty/fee amount, cancellation window evaluation, refund eligibility, and processing channel. For no-shows: records no-show date, no-show fee charged, guarantee method used for charge, automatic guarantee charge processing, and OTA chargeback eligibility. Common fields: waiver flag, waiver reason, posting status to guest folio, processing agent/channel, and any subsequent dispute or reversal. Critical for revenue leakage analysis, NRR policy enforcement, revenue recovery operations, OTA chargeback management, and CPOR (Cost Per Occupied Room) reporting.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code

attributes.name: company_name

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

products.name: reservation_rate_plan
products.description: Reservation-scoped reference master for the bookable rate plan catalog presented to guests and agents via CRS and PMS. Includes BAR (Best Available Rate), LRA (Last Room Availability), NRR (Non-Refundable Rate), corporate negotiated rates, package rates, and promotional rates. Stores rate plan code, rate plan name, rate category, cancellation policy reference, guarantee requirements, minimum LOS restrictions, advance purchase requirements, and channel eligibility flags. SSOT BOUNDARY: This domain owns the bookable rate plan catalog (what can be sold and under what terms). The revenue domain owns rate strategy, pricing optimization, yield management, and dynamic rate amounts. Rate plan records here are synchronized from Sabre SynXis CRS rate configuration and reflect IDeaS G3 RMS rate strategy outputs as read-only pricing inputs.

attributes.name: advance_purchase_days

attributes.name: booking_window_end_days

attributes.name: channel_corporate_flag

attributes.name: channel_direct_flag

attributes.name: channel_gds_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan is available for booking through GDS channels (Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo, Worldspan). Typically used for corporate and travel agent bookings.

attributes.name: channel_group_flag

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: guarantee_method
attributes.description: The method by which the reservation must be guaranteed. Credit card: hold on card; Deposit: partial payment required; Prepayment: full payment required; Direct bill: corporate account billing; None: no guarantee required.

attributes.name: guarantee_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a payment guarantee (credit card, deposit, or prepayment) is required at the time of booking for this rate plan. True for most rate plans; false for select corporate or group rates with direct billing arrangements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rate plan record was last updated. Used for change tracking and synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: loyalty_eligible_flag

attributes.name: loyalty_points_multiplier

attributes.name: package_description

attributes.name: package_inclusion_flag

attributes.name: rate_plan_category

attributes.name: rate_plan_description

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_id

attributes.name: applies_to_corporate_bookings

attributes.name: applies_to_group_bookings
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy can be applied to group block reservations. Group policies often have different terms than individual FIT (Free Independent Traveler) bookings.

attributes.name: channel_restrictions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of booking channels where this policy applies or is restricted. Examples: direct_only, ota_excluded, gds_only. Null indicates no channel restrictions.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who created this cancellation policy. Part of audit trail for policy governance.

attributes.name: deposit_due_days_before_arrival

attributes.name: deposit_percentage

attributes.name: display_order

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this cancellation policy is no longer active for new reservations. Null indicates policy is currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this cancellation policy becomes active and can be applied to new reservations. Part of policy lifecycle management.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: free_cancellation_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days before scheduled arrival date during which a guest can cancel without penalty. Alternative to hours-based window for longer lead-time policies.

attributes.name: free_cancellation_window_hours

attributes.name: guarantee_required

attributes.name: guest_facing_summary

attributes.name: internal_notes

attributes.name: is_non_refundable

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user

attributes.name: penalty_percentage

attributes.name: penalty_type

attributes.name: policy_code

attributes.name: policy_description

attributes.name: policy_name

attributes.name: policy_tier

attributes.name: seasonal_override_allowed

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record where this cancellation policy was originally configured. Typically Oracle OPERA PMS (Property Management System) or Sabre SynXis CRS (Central Reservation System).
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - AHLA Technology

attributes.name: source_system_code
