attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this group evaluation record was first captured in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used for data lineage and ETL audit trail.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; SOX — Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this evaluation record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting per USALI and IFRS/GAAP standards.

attributes.name: cutoff_date
attributes.description: The date by which unbooked rooms in the group block are released back to general inventory. After this date, the property may sell unreserved block rooms to transient guests. Critical for inventory management and wash factor actualization.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS — Group Block Management; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: decision_override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text justification provided by the revenue manager when their decision overrides the RMS recommendation (e.g., strategic account relationship, future business potential, competitive displacement risk). Required when revenue_manager_decision differs from rms_recommendation.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the revenue manager recorded their final accept, decline, or counter-offer decision. Used for SLA tracking and decision audit trail.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; SOX — Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: departure_date
attributes.description: Proposed last night of the group room block (checkout date). Defines the end of the displacement analysis window.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: displacement_cost
attributes.description: Total estimated revenue lost from displaced transient business if the group block is accepted, calculated as transient_rooms_displaced multiplied by transient_adr_displaced across the stay period. Key component of the net revenue impact analysis.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Displacement Analysis Module; USALI; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: evaluation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the group evaluation workflow. Tracks progression from initial inquiry receipt through revenue manager decision. 'pending' = awaiting RMS analysis; 'under_review' = revenue manager reviewing; 'recommended_accept' = RMS recommends acceptance; 'recommended_decline' = RMS recommends decline; 'accepted' = revenue manager approved; 'declined' = revenue manager rejected.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: evaluation_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world event timestamp when the group evaluation was initiated and processed by IDeaS G3 RMS. Represents the business event time, distinct from record audit timestamps.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module

attributes.name: fb_revenue_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated Food and Beverage (F&B) revenue contribution from the group, including banquet, catering, and outlet spend. Sourced from Delphi by Amadeus event catering estimates and historical group F&B spend patterns.
attributes.references: Delphi by Amadeus — Catering Module; USALI — F&B Department

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Name of the group or event associated with the booking inquiry (e.g., 'Acme Corp Annual Sales Conference 2025'). Used for identification and reporting across Delphi by Amadeus and Oracle OPERA PMS.
attributes.references: Delphi by Amadeus — Group Block Management; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: group_room_revenue
attributes.description: Total projected room revenue from the group block at the proposed group rate, calculated as adjusted room block (post-wash) multiplied by proposed_group_rate across all nights. Gross revenue contribution from rooms only.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; USALI

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Classification of the group by business segment. Drives wash factor parameters and attrition modeling in IDeaS G3 RMS. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: corporate|association|government|leisure|sports|wedding|social|tour_operator|incentive — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; AHLA Group Business Standards

attributes.name: historical_wash_pct
attributes.description: Historical average wash percentage for this group type and property, derived from past group performance data in IDeaS G3 RMS. Serves as the baseline input before adjustments for lead time and current demand conditions.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Wash Factor Modeling; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: inquiry_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to the group booking inquiry, as generated by the Central Reservation System (CRS) or Property Management System (PMS). Used to cross-reference the evaluation with the originating inquiry across Oracle OPERA PMS and Sabre SynXis CRS.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: is_definite_booking
attributes.description: Indicates whether the group inquiry has converted to a definite (contracted) booking following a positive revenue manager decision. True = definite booking confirmed; False = still in tentative or evaluation stage.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS — Group Block Management; Delphi by Amadeus

attributes.name: lead_time_bucket
attributes.description: Categorical bucket representing the number of days between the group inquiry date and the proposed arrival date. Used as a parameter in wash factor modeling, as groups booked further in advance typically exhibit higher wash rates.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Wash Factor Modeling; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: los_nights
attributes.description: Total number of nights in the proposed group stay, calculated as departure_date minus arrival_date. Represents the Length of Stay (LOS) for the group block used in displacement and revenue impact modeling.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; USALI

attributes.name: minimum_acceptable_rate
attributes.description: The minimum per-room per-night rate recommended by IDeaS G3 RMS below which accepting the group would result in negative net revenue impact after accounting for displacement costs. This is the RMS-generated floor rate for negotiation.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: net_revenue_impact
attributes.description: Net revenue impact of accepting the group, calculated as total group spend (room + F&B + ancillary) minus displacement cost. Positive value indicates the group is accretive; negative value indicates the group destroys revenue versus transient alternative. Primary decision metric in the evaluation.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Displacement Analysis Module; USALI; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: peak_night_rooms
attributes.description: Maximum number of rooms occupied on any single night within the group block. Used for capacity planning and displacement analysis at the peak demand point.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; AHLA Group Business Standards

attributes.name: proposed_group_rate
attributes.description: The per-room per-night rate proposed by the group organizer or sales manager for the room block, expressed in the property's operating currency. This is the rate under evaluation against the displacement cost and minimum acceptable rate.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; USALI; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: revenue_manager_decision
attributes.description: Final decision made by the revenue manager after reviewing the RMS recommendation and displacement analysis. May align with or override the RMS recommendation. 'pending' indicates no decision has been recorded yet.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: revpar_impact
attributes.description: Estimated change in Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) for the property during the group stay dates if the group is accepted, compared to the transient-only forecast. Negative RevPAR impact is a key indicator for decline recommendation.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; STR STAR Report; USALI

attributes.name: rgi_benchmark
attributes.description: The property's Revenue Generation Index (RGI) from the STR STAR Report for the competitive set during the evaluation period. Used as a competitive context benchmark to assess whether accepting the group at the proposed rate is competitively rational.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report — Revenue Generation Index (RGI); Infor EzRMS — Competitive Benchmarking

attributes.name: rms_recommendation
attributes.description: Automated accept, decline, or counter-offer recommendation generated by IDeaS G3 RMS based on displacement analysis, wash factor modeling, and net revenue impact. This is the system-generated recommendation prior to revenue manager override.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module

attributes.name: room_block_size
attributes.description: Total number of guest rooms requested in the group block across all nights of the stay. This is the peak or contracted room block size as submitted in the group inquiry.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating operational system (IDeaS G3 RMS group evaluation ID or Delphi by Amadeus opportunity ID). Enables traceability back to the system of record for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; Delphi by Amadeus

attributes.name: transient_adr_displaced
attributes.description: The forecasted Average Daily Rate (ADR) of the transient business that would be displaced by the group block, as estimated by IDeaS G3 RMS. Used to quantify the revenue opportunity cost of accepting the group.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Displacement Analysis Module; STR STAR Report; USALI

attributes.name: transient_rooms_displaced
attributes.description: Estimated number of transient (individual) room nights that would be displaced if the group block is accepted, as calculated by IDeaS G3 RMS displacement analysis. Core input to the net revenue impact calculation.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Displacement Analysis Module; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this group evaluation record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse, including revenue manager decision updates or status changes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; SOX — Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: wash_factor_pct
attributes.description: The adjusted wash factor percentage applied to the contracted room block to estimate actual pickup. Derived from historical wash percentage, group type attrition patterns, and booking lead time bucket. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 15.00 = 15% wash). Used to calculate the adjusted room block for revenue modeling.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Wash Factor Modeling; AHLA Group Business Standards

products.name: pickup_report
products.description: Reservation pickup tracking records measuring the pace of bookings against forecast for a given stay date and property. Captures stay date, report date, rooms on books at various lead-time snapshots (90-day, 60-day, 30-day, 14-day, 7-day, 1-day), ADR on books, RevPAR on books, pickup velocity, and variance to forecast. Critical for revenue managers to assess booking pace and adjust pricing strategy.

attributes.name: pickup_report_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each pickup report record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete revenue management snapshot event tracking booking pace against forecast for a given stay date and property.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: active_promotion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.promotion. Business justification: Pickup velocity spikes are frequently driven by loyalty promotions; revenue managers correlate booking pace with active promotions in daily pickup reports. Named process: promotion-driven pickup veloc

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Pickup velocity reports are used to measure whether a marketing campaign is driving booking pace — a named revenue management process. Revenue managers monitor pickup reports during campaign flights t

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Pickup reports track booking pace by channel — a core revenue management daily process. FK from pickup_report to channel enables channel-level pickup velocity analysis and channel mix optimization dec

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Pickup velocity and booking pace are tracked by cost center for departmental revenue forecasting and operational planning at the department level.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.demand_forecast. Business justification: pickup_report tracks reservation pace against forecast for a given stay date. Adding demand_forecast_id links each pickup report to the specific demand forecast it measures pace against. The forecaste

attributes.name: event_booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to event.event_booking. Business justification: Pickup velocity reports track room block pickup rates for specific event bookings against cutoff dates. Essential for group pace reporting, attrition risk assessment, and event booking performance mon

attributes.name: event_group_block_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to event.event_group_block. Business justification: Pickup reports monitor room pickup velocity against group blocks — the event_group_block is the primary source of group room pickup data. Revenue managers use this link to track block-to-pickup ratios

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Pickup reports are used in period-close revenue reconciliation processes. Finance teams require pickup data tagged to fiscal periods for month-end accruals and revenue recognition reporting under USAL

attributes.name: fnb_revenue_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.revenue_center. Business justification: Revenue managers run F&B pickup reports segmented by revenue center (restaurant vs. bar vs. banquet) to track F&B pace alongside room pickup for total revenue management. The existing monitored_fnb_ou

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.market_segment. Business justification: Pickup reports track booking pace by market segment. pickup_report has segment_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK. N pickup_report records → 1 market_segment. Removes redundant segment_cod

attributes.name: monitored_fnb_outlet_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.fnb_outlet. Business justification: Pickup reports track outlet reservation pace for outlets accepting reservations (fine dining, specialty restaurants). Required for outlet capacity planning, labor scheduling, inventory management alig

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property (hotel, resort, or vacation property) for which this pickup report is generated. Links to the property master record in the Property domain.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS — Property Configuration Module

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.revenue_rate_plan. Business justification: pickup_report.rate_plan_code (STRING) is a denormalized reference to the rate plan being tracked. Adding revenue_rate_plan_id normalizes this to the authoritative revenue_rate_plan record. rate_plan_c

attributes.name: seasonal_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.seasonal_calendar. Business justification: Pickup velocity reports are analyzed in the context of seasonal demand periods to assess booking pace relative to seasonal norms. Linking pickup_report to seasonal_calendar enables pace-vs-season benc

attributes.name: strategy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.strategy. Business justification: Pickup reports measure booking pace against the revenue strategy targets for a given stay date. Linking pickup_report to strategy enables revenue managers to assess whether pace is on track to meet st

attributes.name: adr_on_books
attributes.description: Average Daily Rate (ADR) of all rooms currently on books for the stay_date as of the report_date. Calculated as total room revenue on books divided by rooms_on_books. Core revenue performance indicator alongside occupancy pace. Expressed in the property's operating currency.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry); STR STAR Report benchmarking standard; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: adr_variance_to_forecast
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Daily Rate (ADR) Variance to Forecast
attributes.description: Difference between adr_on_books and forecasted_adr (adr_on_books minus forecasted_adr). Positive value indicates rate is tracking above forecast; negative value indicates rate is below forecast. Used alongside rooms_variance_to_forecast to assess overall revenue pace.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pickup report record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED requirement.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (data integrity and accountability); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — audit trail requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values in this pickup report record (adr_on_books, forecasted_adr, revpar_on_books, forecasted_revpar, prior_year_adr, adr_variance_to_forecast). Typically the property's local operating currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP (International Financial Reporting Standards / Generally Accepted Accounting Principles)

attributes.name: day_of_week
attributes.description: Day of the week corresponding to the stay_date (e.g., Monday, Friday, Saturday). Critical demand pattern dimension — weekday vs weekend demand profiles differ significantly in hospitality, driving different pricing strategies and pace expectations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Monday|Tuesday|Wednesday|Thursday|Friday|Saturday|Sunday — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Demand Forecasting; Infor EzRMS — Competitive Benchmarking

attributes.name: demand_level
attributes.description: Revenue management system classification of expected demand intensity for the stay_date as of the report_date. Drives pricing strategy and inventory control decisions: 'distressed' triggers promotional actions; 'peak' triggers rate maximization and LOS (Length of Stay) restrictions.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Inventory Controls; Infor EzRMS — Revenue Strategy

attributes.name: forecasted_adr
attributes.description: Revenue management system forecast for the expected ADR (Average Daily Rate) on the stay_date, as generated by IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS. Baseline against which adr_on_books is compared to assess rate performance vs plan.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Forecasting Module; Infor EzRMS — Revenue Strategy

attributes.name: forecasted_revpar
attributes.description: Revenue management system forecast for RevPAR (Revenue Per Available Room) on the stay_date. Baseline against which revpar_on_books is compared to assess overall revenue pace vs plan. Expressed in the property's operating currency.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Forecasting Module; Infor EzRMS — Revenue Strategy; USALI

attributes.name: forecasted_rooms
attributes.description: Revenue management system forecast for total rooms expected to be occupied on the stay_date, as generated by IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS at the time of this report snapshot. Baseline against which rooms_on_books pace is measured to compute variance.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Forecasting Module; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: is_special_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stay_date coincides with a designated special event (conference, concert, sporting event, holiday, local festival) that materially impacts demand. When true, pace expectations and pricing strategies are adjusted relative to normal demand patterns.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Event Calendar; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: is_weekend
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stay_date falls on a weekend (Saturday or Sunday). Boolean flag used to segment pickup reports into weekday vs weekend cohorts for pace analysis, as weekend demand patterns and pricing strategies differ materially from weekday.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Demand Forecasting; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days between the report_date and the stay_date (stay_date minus report_date). Represents the booking window or days-out at the time of this snapshot. Critical for pace analysis — revenue managers compare pickup velocity across standard lead-time intervals (90, 60, 30, 14, 7, 1 days out).
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: los_restriction_active
attributes.business_glossary_term: Length of Stay (LOS) Restriction Active Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a LOS (Length of Stay) restriction (minimum stay requirement) is currently active for the stay_date. LOS restrictions are a key revenue management lever applied during high-demand periods to maximize total revenue across multiple nights.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Inventory Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS — Rate Distribution

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights a guest must stay to book the stay_date, when a LOS restriction is active. Null when los_restriction_active is false. Used to enforce stay-through requirements during high-demand periods to prevent short-stay displacement of longer, higher-value bookings.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Inventory Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS — Rate Distribution

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text annotations entered by the revenue manager to document observations, strategy decisions, or contextual factors affecting the pickup pace for this stay_date (e.g., 'Rate opened on OTA due to slow pace', 'Group block released — expect transient pickup'). Supports audit trail and strategy documentation.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: pickup_velocity
attributes.description: Rate of new reservations being added per day for the stay_date, calculated as the incremental rooms picked up divided by the number of days elapsed in the measurement window. Expressed as rooms per day. Enables revenue managers to assess acceleration or deceleration of booking pace.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: prior_year_adr
attributes.description: ADR (Average Daily Rate) on books for the equivalent stay_date in the prior year, at the same lead time. Enables year-over-year rate comparison to assess whether current pricing strategy is yielding rate improvement or erosion versus the prior period.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; STR STAR Report benchmarking standard; USALI

attributes.name: prior_year_rooms_on_books
attributes.description: Number of rooms that were on books for the equivalent stay_date in the prior year, at the same lead time (days out). Enables year-over-year (YOY) pace comparison — a standard revenue management benchmarking technique to contextualize current booking pace against historical performance.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; STR STAR Report benchmarking standard; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: report_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this pickup snapshot was captured. Represents the 'as-of' date for all rooms-on-books and ADR figures in this record. The difference between stay_date and report_date defines the lead time (days out). Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP requirement (date-precision is standard for daily pickup reports).
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: report_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this pickup report record, typically formatted as PKP-{PropertyCode}-{StayDate}-{SequenceNumber}. Used by revenue managers to reference specific pickup snapshots in IDeaS G3 RMS and Infor EzRMS reporting. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER requirement.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: report_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this pickup report record. 'draft' indicates the snapshot is being assembled; 'published' indicates it is available for revenue manager consumption; 'superseded' indicates a later snapshot for the same stay_date/report_date exists; 'cancelled' indicates the report was voided. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS requirement.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pickup report generation cadence: 'daily' for standard automated daily snapshots, 'weekly' for weekly pace summaries, 'monthly' for month-end pace reviews, or 'adhoc' for analyst-triggered on-demand reports. Determines the reporting frequency context for pace trend analysis.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Revenue Strategy

attributes.name: revpar_on_books
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) on Books
attributes.description: Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) derived from current on-books position, calculated as (adr_on_books multiplied by rooms_on_books) divided by total_available_rooms. Composite pace metric combining rate and occupancy performance. Expressed in the property's operating currency.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry); STR STAR Report benchmarking standard; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: room_type_code
attributes.description: Room type classification for which this pickup report is scoped (e.g., STD, DLX, STE, KNG, DBL). When null, the report covers all room types for the property. Enables room-type-level pace analysis to support inventory controls and upsell strategy.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS — Room Type Configuration; IDeaS G3 RMS — Inventory Controls

attributes.name: rooms_on_books
attributes.description: Total number of rooms confirmed on books for the stay_date as of the report_date. This is the primary pace indicator — the current committed inventory position. Revenue managers compare this against forecast and prior-year actuals to assess demand trajectory.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Oracle OPERA PMS — Reservations

attributes.name: rooms_on_books_14d
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rooms on Books at 14 Days Out
attributes.description: Number of rooms that were on books for the stay_date when the lead time was 14 days (i.e., the snapshot captured 14 days prior to stay_date). Critical short-window pace indicator used to trigger last-minute pricing tactics and inventory controls.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: rooms_on_books_1d
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rooms on Books at 1 Day Out
attributes.description: Number of rooms that were on books for the stay_date when the lead time was 1 day (i.e., the snapshot captured 1 day prior to stay_date). Final pre-arrival pace indicator representing near-final committed occupancy before day-of walk-ins.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Oracle OPERA PMS — Reservations

attributes.name: rooms_on_books_30d
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rooms on Books at 30 Days Out
attributes.description: Number of rooms that were on books for the stay_date when the lead time was 30 days (i.e., the snapshot captured 30 days prior to stay_date). Key pace benchmark for near-term demand assessment and rate strategy adjustments.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: rooms_on_books_60d
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rooms on Books at 60 Days Out
attributes.description: Number of rooms that were on books for the stay_date when the lead time was 60 days (i.e., the snapshot captured 60 days prior to stay_date). Standard pace benchmark used by revenue managers to assess mid-range booking momentum.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: rooms_on_books_7d
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rooms on Books at 7 Days Out
attributes.description: Number of rooms that were on books for the stay_date when the lead time was 7 days (i.e., the snapshot captured 7 days prior to stay_date). Near-arrival pace indicator used to assess last-week demand and trigger promotional or restriction actions.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: rooms_on_books_90d
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rooms on Books at 90 Days Out
attributes.description: Number of rooms that were on books for the stay_date when the lead time was 90 days (i.e., the snapshot captured 90 days prior to stay_date). Used as a historical pace benchmark for comparison against current rooms_on_books to measure pickup velocity over the 90-day window.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: rooms_variance_to_forecast
attributes.description: Difference between rooms_on_books and forecasted_rooms (rooms_on_books minus forecasted_rooms). Positive value indicates ahead-of-pace (over-performing vs forecast); negative value indicates behind-pace (under-performing). Primary KPI for revenue manager intervention decisions.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Revenue Strategy

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this pickup report data was sourced (IDeaS_G3_RMS, Infor_EzRMS, OPERA_PMS, or Manual for analyst-entered overrides). Enables data lineage tracking and source-system reconciliation in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; Oracle OPERA PMS; AHLA Technology (HTNG) data standards

attributes.name: special_event_name
attributes.description: Name or description of the special event associated with the stay_date when is_special_event is true (e.g., 'Super Bowl Weekend', 'Annual Tech Conference', 'New Year's Eve'). Provides context for anomalous pace patterns in revenue management reporting.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Event Calendar; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: stay_date
attributes.description: The specific calendar date for which booking pace and pickup velocity are being measured. This is the future arrival/occupancy date that revenue managers are monitoring. Central dimension of the pickup report — all rooms-on-books and ADR snapshots relate to this date.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; STR STAR Report benchmarking standard

attributes.name: total_available_rooms
attributes.description: Total number of rooms available for sale for the stay_date at the property (net of out-of-order and out-of-service rooms). Denominator for occupancy rate (OCC) calculation and RevPAR computation. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS inventory controls.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS — Housekeeping and Inventory; USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pickup report record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED requirement.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — audit trail requirements; GDPR Article 5

products.name: negotiated_rate
products.description: Corporate and wholesale negotiated rate agreements defining contracted pricing for specific accounts, travel management companies (TMCs), and consortia. Captures account identifier, rate code, negotiated rate amount, LRA (Last Room Availability) obligation, blackout dates, minimum night commitment, contract period, and rate loading status in Sabre SynXis CRS and Oracle OPERA PMS. Distinct from public rate plans — these are account-specific contracted rates.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: is_non_refundable

attributes.name: min_night_commitment

Captures strategy period, property, strategy type (transient, group, total revenue), target ADR, target occupancy, target RevPAR, key tactical actions, strategy status (draft, approved, active), and approving revenue director. Provides governance and audit trail for strategic revenue decisions.

Linking strategy to the seasonal period

attributes.name: superseded_by_strategy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer revenue strategy record that replaced this one when status is 'superseded'. Enables lineage tracking of strategy evolution and supports audit trail for revenue governance.

attributes.name: target_tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier. Business justification: Revenue strategies are often tier-targeted (e.g., drive Platinum member bookings in shoulder season, protect Gold tier inventory). Named process: tier-targeted revenue strategy planning and execution.

attributes.name: activated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the strategy status transitioned to 'active' and began governing live pricing and inventory decisions. Distinct from approval timestamp — a strategy may be approved in advance and activated at a later point.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the Revenue Director or authorized revenue management leader who formally approved this strategy. Provides governance and audit trail for strategic revenue decisions per SOX internal controls requirements.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the revenue strategy was formally approved by the authorizing Revenue Director. Establishes the official approval event in the strategy lifecycle for governance and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: channel_focus
attributes.description: The primary distribution channel(s) this strategy targets for demand generation (e.g., 'Direct Web', 'GDS', 'OTA', 'Voice/CRS', 'Corporate Direct'). Informs channel mix optimization and OTA partnership management decisions. Aligns with Sabre SynXis CRS channel codes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this revenue strategy record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for the strategy lifecycle.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary target values in this strategy record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency property portfolios.

attributes.name: horizon_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the temporal scope of the strategy planning horizon. 'weekly' for short-term tactical adjustments, 'monthly' for rolling monthly plans, 'quarterly' for seasonal strategies, 'annual' for full-year budget-aligned strategies, 'event_based' for strategies tied to specific demand events.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; STR STAR Report

attributes.name: inventory_control_approach
attributes.description: The approved inventory management methodology for this strategy period. 'open' allows all bookings, 'hurdle_rate' applies minimum rate thresholds, 'length_of_stay' (LOS) enforces minimum/maximum stay restrictions, 'nested' uses tiered availability controls, 'closed' restricts availability for specific segments or channels.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Oracle OPERA PMS; AHLA

attributes.name: key_tactical_actions
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documenting the specific tactical actions approved as part of this strategy (e.g., 'Open BAR for all channels on shoulder nights', 'Apply 5-night minimum LOS restriction over peak weekend', 'Close OTA channels when occupancy exceeds 85%'). Provides governance documentation for revenue decisions.
attributes.references: USALI; SOX Section 302; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next formal performance review of this revenue strategy. Drives workflow triggers in the revenue management calendar and ensures timely strategy adjustments based on actual vs. target performance.
attributes.references: AHLA Revenue Management Standards; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text commentary, rationale, or contextual notes provided by the revenue management team regarding this strategy. May include market intelligence, competitive observations, or risk considerations not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the planning period covered by this revenue strategy. Together with planning_horizon_start_date, defines the full strategy window for yield optimization and performance tracking.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; USALI

attributes.name: planning_horizon_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the planning period covered by this revenue strategy. Defines the beginning of the stay-date window over which the strategy governs pricing and inventory decisions.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; USALI

attributes.name: pricing_approach
attributes.description: The approved pricing methodology governing rate-setting for this strategy period. 'bar_based' uses Best Available Rate (BAR) as the anchor, 'dynamic' applies algorithmic Dynamic Rate Rules (DRR), 'fixed' uses static rate plans, 'hybrid' combines approaches, 'competitive_parity' aligns rates to competitive set benchmarks.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: The approved cadence at which this strategy is scheduled for performance review and potential revision by the revenue management team. Governs the operational rhythm of the revenue management process.
attributes.references: AHLA Revenue Management Standards; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: rms_strategy_reference_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revenue Management System (RMS) Strategy Reference ID
attributes.description: The native strategy or scenario identifier from the source Revenue Management System (IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS). Enables traceability back to the originating RMS record for reconciliation and system-of-record alignment.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this strategy record originated. 'IDeaS_G3_RMS' for strategies generated by IDeaS G3, 'Infor_EzRMS' for Infor-sourced strategies, 'Manual' for strategies entered directly by revenue management staff.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; HTNG

attributes.name: special_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this strategy was created in response to a specific demand-driving special event (e.g., major conference, sporting event, concert, holiday period). When True, the strategy may include event-specific pricing premiums and inventory controls.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; AHLA

attributes.name: special_event_name
attributes.description: Name of the demand-driving special event associated with this strategy when special_event_flag is True (e.g., 'Super Bowl LX', 'Annual Medical Conference', 'New Year Holiday Period'). Provides context for strategy rationale and post-event performance analysis.

attributes.name: strategy_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this revenue strategy record within the Revenue Management System (RMS). Used for cross-system reference and audit trail. Sourced from IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS strategy identifiers.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; USALI

attributes.name: strategy_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the revenue strategy (e.g., 'Q3 2025 Transient Yield Push', 'Holiday Season Total Revenue Strategy'). Used for identification in reporting and governance workflows.

attributes.name: strategy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the revenue strategy record. 'draft' indicates work-in-progress, 'pending_approval' awaits revenue director sign-off, 'approved' is authorized but not yet in effect, 'active' is currently governing pricing decisions, 'superseded' has been replaced by a newer strategy, 'archived' is retained for historical audit.
attributes.references: USALI; SOX Section 302 — internal controls documentation; AHLA

attributes.name: strategy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the revenue strategy by business segment. 'transient' covers individual guest pricing, 'group' covers group block strategies, 'total_revenue' encompasses all revenue streams (TRevPAR focus), 'food_and_beverage' targets F&B revenue optimization, 'events' covers MICE and event revenue. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: transient|group|total_revenue|food_and_beverage|events|loyalty — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: USALI; STR STAR Report; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: target_adr
attributes.description: The approved target Average Daily Rate (ADR) in the property's operating currency for the strategy period. ADR is the primary pricing KPI representing average revenue earned per occupied room per night. Used to benchmark actual ADR performance against strategic intent.
attributes.references: USALI; STR STAR Report; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: target_ari
attributes.description: The approved target Average Rate Index (ARI) for the strategy period. ARI = Property ADR / Competitive Set ADR. Measures the property's rate positioning relative to its competitive set. Used alongside MPI and RGI for comprehensive competitive benchmarking.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report; AHLA; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: target_goppar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR)
attributes.description: The approved target Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR) for the strategy period. GOPPAR incorporates operating costs and provides a profitability-adjusted view of revenue performance, aligned with USALI GOP reporting standards.

attributes.name: target_mpi
attributes.description: The approved target Market Penetration Index (MPI) for the strategy period. MPI = Property Occupancy / Competitive Set Occupancy. Measures the property's occupancy share relative to its competitive set as defined in STR STAR Report.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report; AHLA; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: target_occupancy_pct
attributes.description: The approved target Occupancy Rate (OCC) expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00) for the strategy period. Represents the proportion of available rooms expected to be sold. Core input to RevPAR calculation and yield optimization decisions.

attributes.name: target_revpar
attributes.description: The approved target Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) in the property's operating currency for the strategy period. RevPAR = ADR × Occupancy Rate. The primary composite KPI for hotel revenue performance and competitive benchmarking via STR STAR Report.
attributes.references: USALI; STR STAR Report; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: target_rgi
attributes.description: The approved target Revenue Generation Index (RGI) for the strategy period. RGI = Property RevPAR / Competitive Set RevPAR. An RGI above 1.0 indicates the property is outperforming its competitive set. Sourced from STR STAR Report benchmarking data.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report; AHLA; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: target_trevpar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Total Revenue Per Available Room (TRevPAR)
attributes.description: The approved target Total Revenue Per Available Room (TRevPAR) encompassing all revenue streams (rooms, F&B, spa, events, ancillary) per available room for the strategy period. Relevant for total revenue strategies beyond rooms-only yield optimization.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the last person to modify this strategy record. Supports change management and audit trail for revenue governance.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this revenue strategy record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change event for audit trail and data lineage purposes in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version number for this strategy record. Increments each time the strategy is revised and re-approved. Supports audit trail and change management for revenue governance workflows.

attributes.name: created_by

domains.name: loyalty
domains.description: Guest loyalty program management including membership enrollment, tier management, points accrual and redemption, elite status benefits, partner integrations, and rewards fulfillment. Tracks member activity, lifetime value (LTV), engagement metrics, SALT (Satisfaction and Loyalty Tracking), and program economics. Supports personalized offers, tier upgrades, and retention campaigns.

products.name: member
products.description: Core master entity representing a guest enrolled in the loyalty program. Captures membership identity, enrollment date, current tier assignment (FK to tier), lifetime points balance, LTV metrics (total revenue, stays, nights), SALT scores, program opt-in preferences, communication consent, membership number, and account status (active, suspended, closed). This is the SSOT for loyalty membership identity and current member state — distinct from the guest profile in the guest domain, which owns PII and stay history. References guest_id as a foreign key to the guest domain. Also serves as the anchor for member segment assignments (segment memberships tracked temporally within member_segment).
products.reference: Loyalty Member / CRM Member Record (Salesforce CRM)

products.name: tier_history

Captures previous tier, new tier, effective date, expiry date, qualification basis (nights/stays/points/spend achieved), qualifying period, qualifying activity summary (total qualifying nights, stays, spend in period), change reason (earned upgrade, annual requalification, downgrade, manual override, status match), and the agent or system that triggered the change. This is the SSOT for tier progression audit trail and requalification decisions — replacing the need for a separate qualifying_activity entity.

products.name: points_ledger
products.description: Authoritative transactional ledger recording every points movement for a loyalty member — including accruals, redemptions, expirations, adjustments, and partner transfers. Each row is an immutable debit or credit entry capturing transaction type (earn, redeem, expire, adjust, transfer_out, transfer_in, bonus), points amount, balance after transaction, source activity (stay, F&B spend, partner purchase, promotion), activity date, posting date, expiry date, originating system reference. For transfer-type entries: partner program reference, transfer direction, conversion rate applied, partner confirmation number, transfer status, and fee charged. This is the SSOT for points balance, movement history, and partner transfer activity.

Enables benefit delivery and tracking at the property level.

attributes.name: benefit_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the benefit, including terms, conditions, and any restrictions or exclusions.

attributes.name: benefit_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the benefit entitlement for display and communication purposes.

attributes.name: benefit_type_code
attributes.description: The category of benefit granted to the member. Examples include complimentary breakfast, room upgrade, late checkout, lounge access, welcome amenity, or bonus points multiplier.

attributes.name: blackout_dates
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of date ranges during which this benefit cannot be redeemed, typically during peak demand periods or special events.

attributes.name: brand_restriction
attributes.description: The brand code if this benefit is restricted to properties within a specific brand. Null if no brand restriction applies.

attributes.name: combinable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit can be combined with other benefits or promotions during the same stay. True if combinable, False if mutually exclusive.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the monetary value of this benefit.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this benefit entitlement becomes valid and can be redeemed by the member.

attributes.name: eligible_property_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of property codes where this benefit can be redeemed. Populated only when property_restriction is SPECIFIC.

attributes.name: entitlement_source
attributes.description: The origin or reason for granting this benefit. Tier standard benefits are automatic based on member tier; status match benefits are granted when matching status from another program; manual grants are discretionary; promotion benefits are campaign-driven; compensation benefits are service recovery; partner benefits come from co-branded or partner integrations.

attributes.name: entitlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit entitlement. Active entitlements can be redeemed; suspended entitlements are temporarily unavailable; expired entitlements have passed their validity period; revoked entitlements have been withdrawn; pending entitlements are awaiting activation.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this benefit entitlement expires and can no longer be redeemed. Null for benefits with no expiration.

attributes.name: granted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this benefit entitlement was created or granted to the member.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this benefit entitlement record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: maximum_stay_nights
attributes.description: The maximum length of stay (LOS) in nights for which this benefit can be applied. Null if no maximum stay restriction exists.

attributes.name: minimum_stay_nights
attributes.description: The minimum length of stay (LOS) in nights required to redeem this benefit. Null if no minimum stay requirement exists.

attributes.name: monetary_value
attributes.description: The estimated monetary value of this benefit in the property's base currency, used for program economics tracking and liability calculation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information about this benefit entitlement.

attributes.name: points_multiplier
attributes.description: The bonus points multiplier applied to eligible stays when this benefit is active. For example, 1.5 means the member earns 50% bonus points. Null if this benefit does not include a points multiplier.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: The priority order for applying this benefit when multiple benefits are available. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used to resolve conflicts when benefits cannot be combined.

attributes.name: property_restriction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit can be redeemed at all properties, only at specific properties, within a specific brand, or within a specific geographic region.

attributes.name: region_restriction
attributes.description: The geographic region code if this benefit is restricted to properties within a specific region. Null if no region restriction applies.

attributes.name: remaining_usage
attributes.description: The number of redemptions remaining for this benefit. Calculated as usage_limit minus usage_count. Null if usage is unlimited.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: The business reason or justification for revoking this benefit entitlement. Null if the benefit has not been revoked.

attributes.name: revoked_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this benefit entitlement was revoked. Null if the benefit has not been revoked.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system that originated this benefit entitlement record (e.g., Salesforce CRM, Oracle OPERA PMS).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this benefit entitlement in the source operational system.

attributes.name: transferable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit can be transferred to another loyalty member. True if transferable, False if non-transferable.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: The number of times this benefit has been redeemed to date. Used to track remaining usage against the usage limit.

attributes.name: usage_limit
attributes.description: The maximum number of times this benefit can be redeemed during its validity period. Null indicates unlimited usage.

products.name: benefit_redemption
products.description: Unified lifecycle entity for loyalty member benefits — from entitlement through consumption or expiry. Captures benefit type (complimentary breakfast, room upgrade, late checkout, lounge access, welcome amenity, bonus points multiplier), entitlement source (tier standard, status match, manual grant, promotion), effective date, expiry date, usage limit, remaining usage count, and delivery records including delivery date, property, reservation reference, delivering staff, member acknowledgment, and exception notes. This is the SSOT for 'what benefits does this member have and which have been used' — enabling benefit fulfillment tracking, elite SLA compliance, and property-level benefit delivery operations.

attributes.name: promotion_type
attributes.description: Classification of the promotion mechanism. Values: bonus_points_multiplier (earn extra points per dollar), double_nights (accelerate tier qualification), targeted_offer (personalized to segment), welcome_back (re-engagement), birthday_bonus (member birthday reward), spend_challenge (gamified spending goal).

attributes.name: qualifying_criteria_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the requirements a member must meet to earn the promotion bonus. Examples: 'Complete 3 stays between June 1 and August 31', 'Spend minimum $500 on F&B (Food and Beverage) during stay', 'Book via mobile app using rate code MOBILE2024'.

attributes.name: qualifying_rate_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of rate codes (BAR - Best Available Rate, corporate codes, promotional codes) that qualify for this promotion. Null or 'ALL' if all rate codes qualify. Example: 'BAR,CORP,PROMO2024'.

attributes.name: registration_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must explicitly register or opt-in to participate in this promotion. True = registration required before qualifying activity counts; False = automatic enrollment for eligible members.

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotion can be combined with other active promotions. True = member can earn bonuses from multiple promotions simultaneously; False = this promotion cannot be stacked with others.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the promotion becomes active and members can begin earning toward the bonus. Qualifying activity before this date does not count.

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_url
attributes.description: Web link to the full legal terms and conditions document for this promotion. Displayed to members during enrollment and in promotional materials.

attributes.name: total_completions
attributes.description: Count of members who have successfully completed all qualifying criteria and earned the promotion bonus. Used for conversion rate and campaign effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: total_enrollments
attributes.description: Count of unique members who have enrolled or been auto-enrolled in this promotion. Used for campaign reach and engagement metrics.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotion record was last modified. Updated whenever any attribute changes. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or employee ID of the marketing or loyalty team member who created this promotion record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: promotion_enrollment
products.description: Transactional association record capturing a loyalty member registering or being enrolled in a specific promotion. Captures enrollment date, enrollment channel, promotion status for the member (enrolled, in-progress, completed, expired, awarded), qualifying activity progress (nights completed, spend accumulated), bonus awarded flag, award date, and opt-out date if applicable. Enables promotion fulfillment tracking and member communication triggers.

attributes.name: promotion_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the promotion enrollment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: campaign_execution_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign_execution. Business justification: Tracks which specific marketing campaign execution (email send, paid ad, social post) drove a member to enroll in a loyalty promotion. Critical for marketing attribution and campaign ROI measurement.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Promotion enrollments must link to distribution channel for campaign channel attribution analysis, measuring which channels drive highest promotion participation rates, and calculating channel-specifi

attributes.name: event_booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to event.event_booking. Business justification: MICE loyalty promotions (e.g., earn bonus points for booking events) enroll members at event booking time. promotion_enrollment has property_code (text) but no event_booking_id. Direct link enables MI

attributes.name: guest_experience_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to experience.guest_experience_enrollment. Business justification: Promotions requiring experience program participation (e.g., 'complete a spa program enrollment to earn bonus points') need the promotion_enrollment to reference the qualifying guest_experience_enroll

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty member who enrolled in the promotion.

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific promotion the member enrolled in.

attributes.name: award_date
attributes.description: Date when the promotion bonus was awarded to the member's account.

attributes.name: award_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number or transaction ID for the bonus award, used for reconciliation and member inquiries.

attributes.name: award_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the bonus was posted to the member's loyalty account.

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the bonus awarded (e.g., account credit, voucher value).

attributes.name: bonus_awarded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the promotion bonus has been awarded to the member (True/False).

attributes.name: bonus_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the bonus amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: bonus_points
attributes.description: Number of bonus loyalty points awarded to the member upon promotion completion.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment was cancelled by the system or staff.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for cancellation of the enrollment (e.g., member ineligibility, promotion terminated, fraud detection).

attributes.name: communication_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether enrollment confirmation communication was sent to the member (True/False).

attributes.name: communication_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the enrollment confirmation communication was sent to the member.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the member completed the qualifying activity requirements for the promotion.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the promotion requirements were completed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the member enrolled or was enrolled in the promotion.

attributes.name: enrollment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the enrollment occurred (opt-in by member, auto-enrolled by system, staff-enrolled, imported from external source).

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for this promotion enrollment, used for member communication and tracking.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the member's participation in the promotion (enrolled, in-progress, completed, expired, awarded, cancelled, opted-out). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: enrolled|in_progress|completed|expired|awarded|cancelled|opted_out — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: enrollment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the enrollment was recorded in the system.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment expires if the member has not completed the promotion requirements.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the enrollment, used for special circumstances or staff annotations.

attributes.name: opt_out_date
attributes.description: Date when the member opted out of the promotion, if applicable.

attributes.name: opt_out_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by the member or system for opting out of the promotion.

attributes.name: progress_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of qualifying activity completed toward the promotion threshold (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: progress_value
attributes.description: Current progress value toward the qualifying threshold (e.g., 3 nights completed out of 5 required).

attributes.name: property_code
attributes.description: Property code where the enrollment occurred, if applicable (e.g., front desk enrollment).

attributes.name: qualifying_activity_type
attributes.description: Type of activity required to complete the promotion (nights stayed, number of stays, revenue spent, points earned, transactions, referrals).

attributes.name: qualifying_threshold
attributes.description: Target threshold value the member must achieve to complete the promotion (e.g., 5 nights, 1000 points, 500 USD revenue).

attributes.name: qualifying_threshold_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the qualifying threshold (nights, stays, points, currency, transactions, referrals).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system that created this enrollment record (e.g., Salesforce CRM, OPERA PMS, Mobile App).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this enrollment record in the source system, used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: tier_at_enrollment
attributes.description: Loyalty tier of the member at the time of enrollment, used for tier-specific promotion eligibility and tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was last modified in the data platform.

products.name: program_config
products.description: Reference master storing the global configuration parameters of the loyalty program. Captures program name, program version, currency name (points, miles, credits), points-to-currency conversion rate, tier year definition (calendar vs. rolling 12-month), minimum redemption threshold, maximum earn per stay, points expiry policy (inactivity period, rolling expiry window), program terms version, GDPR/CCPA data retention policy, breakage assumption rate, and active status. Single configuration record governing program-wide business rules and program economics assumptions.

attributes.name: program_config_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty program configuration record. Primary key. This is the single source of truth configuration governing program-wide business rules and economics.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: A loyalty program configuration is scoped to a brand (e.g., Marriott Bonvoy for Marriott brands). Linking program_config to brand enables brand-level loyalty program governance, co-branded marketing r

attributes.name: liability_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Hotel loyalty programs maintain a dedicated deferred revenue liability GL account configured at the program level (IFRS 15 / ASC 606 compliance). Role-prefix 'liability_' used because program_config h

attributes.name: api_integration_enabled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: API (Application Programming Interface) Integration Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether external systems can integrate with this loyalty program via API. True = API access available for partners and properties; False = manual integration only.

attributes.name: breakage_assumption_rate
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of earned points that will never be redeemed (e.g., 0.1500 = 15%). Used for USALI-compliant revenue recognition and liability estimation. Based on historical redemption patterns.

attributes.name: cash_plus_points_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members can combine cash and points for redemptions. True = hybrid payment allowed; False = points-only or cash-only redemptions.

attributes.name: ccpa_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this program configuration meets CCPA requirements for California resident data. True = CCPA controls implemented; False = non-California program or pending compliance.

attributes.name: configuration_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this specific configuration version became effective. Used for time-based rule application and member communication of program changes.

attributes.name: configuration_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this configuration version expires and is replaced by a new version. Null if currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: contact_center_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for member inquiries and loyalty program support. Used for member communication and published on program website.

attributes.name: contact_center_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for member services and loyalty program support. Used for member communication materials and website display.

attributes.name: conversion_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the points-to-currency conversion rate (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Defines the monetary unit for program economics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this configuration record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_name
attributes.description: Name of the loyalty currency unit (e.g., 'Points', 'Miles', 'Credits', 'Stars'). This is the term displayed to members for their balance.

attributes.name: data_retention_policy_months
attributes.description: Number of months member data is retained after account closure, per GDPR and CCPA requirements. After this period, PII is purged per right-to-erasure regulations.

attributes.name: family_pooling_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members can pool points with family members into a shared account. True = pooling allowed; False = pooling disabled.

attributes.name: gdpr_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this program configuration meets GDPR requirements for EU member data. True = GDPR controls implemented; False = non-EU program or pending compliance.

attributes.name: gifting_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members can gift points to other members. True = gifting allowed; False = gifting disabled. Subject to anti-fraud controls.

attributes.name: inactivity_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months of account inactivity (no earn or redeem transactions) before points expire, if points_expiry_policy is 'inactivity_based'. Null otherwise.

attributes.name: liability_estimation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method for estimating loyalty program liability. incremental_cost = cost to fulfill; fair_value = market value of rewards; redemption_value = points * conversion rate. Must align with USALI and ASC 606.

attributes.name: lifetime_status_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program offers lifetime elite status after achieving cumulative thresholds. True = lifetime tiers available; False = annual re-qualification required.

attributes.name: maximum_earn_per_stay
attributes.description: Maximum number of points a member can earn from a single stay, regardless of spend. Null if no cap applies. Used to manage program liability.

attributes.name: minimum_redemption_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum number of points required to initiate any redemption transaction. Prevents micro-redemptions and reduces operational costs.

attributes.name: mobile_app_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a dedicated mobile application is available for this loyalty program. True = mobile app available; False = web-only access.

attributes.name: partner_transfer_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members can transfer points to partner programs (airlines, car rentals, etc.). True = transfers allowed; False = transfers disabled.

attributes.name: points_expiry_policy
attributes.description: Rule governing when points expire. no_expiry = points never expire; inactivity_based = expire after N months of no activity; fixed_period = expire after N months from earn date; rolling_expiry = expire on a rolling window.

attributes.name: points_purchase_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members can purchase additional points with cash. True = purchase allowed; False = earn-only program. Subject to regulatory limits in some jurisdictions.

attributes.name: points_to_currency_conversion_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate for converting loyalty points to monetary value (e.g., 0.0100 means 100 points = 1 USD). Used for redemption valuation and breakage accounting per USALI standards.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this loyalty program in operational systems (e.g., 'HNRS', 'ELITE01'). Used for system integration and reporting.

attributes.name: program_launch_date
attributes.description: Date when the loyalty program was originally launched. Used for program anniversary communications and historical analysis.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Official marketing name of the loyalty program (e.g., 'Honors Rewards', 'Elite Guest Club'). This is the customer-facing brand name.

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the loyalty program. Active programs accept enrollments and transactions; suspended programs are temporarily paused; sunset programs are being phased out.

attributes.name: program_terms_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the legal terms and conditions document governing this program configuration. Links to the published T&C document for member consent and compliance.

attributes.name: program_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the program configuration (e.g., '2.1', '3.0.1'). Incremented when program rules or economics change materially.

attributes.name: program_website_url
attributes.description: Primary website URL for the loyalty program where members can view terms, check balances, and redeem rewards. Used for marketing and member self-service.

attributes.name: program_year_start_month
attributes.description: Month number (1-12) when the program year begins if tier_year_definition is 'program_year'. Null for calendar or rolling definitions. 1=January, 12=December.

attributes.name: rolling_expiry_window_months
attributes.description: Number of months from earn date after which points expire, if points_expiry_policy is 'rolling_expiry'. Null otherwise. Example: 24 means points earned on Jan 1, 2023 expire Jan 1, 2025.

attributes.name: status_match_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program offers status matching from competitor loyalty programs. True = status match campaigns allowed; False = earn-only tier qualification.

attributes.name: terms_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current program terms and conditions became effective. Used for member communication and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: tier_rollover_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether qualifying nights/stays can roll over to the next qualification period if a member exceeds their tier threshold. True = rollover allowed; False = no rollover.

attributes.name: tier_year_definition
attributes.description: Method for calculating the qualification period for tier status. Calendar = Jan 1 - Dec 31; rolling_12_month = trailing 12 months from any date; program_year = custom fiscal period.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this configuration record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

domains.name: channel
domains.description: Distribution channel management including OTA partnerships, GDS connectivity, direct booking channels, CRS (Sabre SynXis) channel mapping, and rate parity monitoring. Manages channel performance, commission structures, connectivity fees, booking source attribution, and channel mix optimization. Tracks cost of acquisition and channel contribution to revenue.
domains.references: HTNG Channel Distribution and CRS Connectivity Standard

products.name: channel
products.description: Master registry of all distribution channels through which Travel Hospitality properties sell inventory, including OTA platforms (Expedia, Booking.com), GDS networks (Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo), direct web/mobile, voice/call center, corporate direct, wholesalers, and metasearch engines. Captures channel type, connectivity method, commission tier, rate parity obligations, and channel-level SLA parameters. This is the SSOT for channel identity across the enterprise.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Primary key for channel

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Distribution channels incur operating costs (connectivity fees, commissions, marketing) that must be allocated to cost centers for USALI-compliant departmental P&L reporting and budget variance analys

attributes.name: ota_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.ota_partner. Business justification: Many distribution channels are operated by OTA partners (e.g., Expedia operates multiple channels/brands). This FK establishes the ownership relationship. Removes redundant platform_name which can be

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this distribution channel was first activated and began accepting live bookings. Distinct from contract_start_date which reflects the commercial agreement date. Used for channel onboarding tracking and performance benchmarking from go-live.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: bar_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this channel is eligible to display and sell the Best Available Rate (BAR) — the lowest publicly available rate at the time of booking. True = BAR rates are distributed to this channel; False = channel receives only specific contracted or negotiated rates. Drives rate distribution strategy in IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis CRS.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: booking_fee_usd
