attributes.name: reservation_booking_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent reservation record in the PMS. Links the channel booking transaction to the operational reservation for end-to-end booking lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Reservations Module; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: adr
attributes.description: The Average Daily Rate (ADR) for this booking, calculated as gross booking value divided by length of stay nights. Stored as a business attribute to support channel-level ADR benchmarking and STR STAR Report comparisons without requiring runtime calculation.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report Standards; USALI Lodging Standards; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: booking_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the channel booking transaction. Drives channel performance reporting, cancellation rate analysis, and no-show tracking. LIFECYCLE_STATUS per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: confirmed|cancelled|modified|no_show|waitlisted|tentative — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Reservations Module; HTNG Data Exchange Standards

attributes.name: booking_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the booking was received through the distribution channel. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role. Used for booking pace analysis, lead time calculation, and channel demand pattern reporting.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; Oracle OPERA PMS; HTNG Data Exchange Standards

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the cancellation policy applicable to this booking (e.g., FREE_CANCEL_24H, NRR_NON_REFUND, FLEX_48H). Determines penalty applicability and refund eligibility for cancelled bookings.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Reservations Module; Sabre SynXis CRS Rate Distribution; AHLA Cancellation Policy Standards

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the booking was cancelled. Populated only when is_cancelled is True. Used for cancellation lead time analysis and channel cancellation pattern reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Reservations Module; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: channel_commission_amount
attributes.description: The commission amount payable to the distribution channel partner for this booking. Represents the cost of acquisition for channel-sourced bookings. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.
attributes.references: USALI Lodging Financial Reporting Standards; SAP S/4HANA Finance AP Module; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the distribution channel category through which the booking was received. Enables channel mix analysis and cost-of-acquisition benchmarking across channel categories. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OTA|GDS|direct_web|voice|corporate|wholesaler|metasearch|travel_agent — promote to reference product if additional types are required]
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Channel Management; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; AHLA Distribution Standards

attributes.name: check_in_date
attributes.description: The scheduled guest arrival date for the stay associated with this booking. Used for stay date demand analysis, length-of-stay (LOS) calculation, and revenue period attribution.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Front Desk Module; USALI Lodging Standards

attributes.name: check_out_date
attributes.description: The scheduled guest departure date for the stay associated with this booking. Combined with check_in_date to derive length of stay (LOS) and average length of stay (ALOS) metrics.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Front Desk Module; USALI Lodging Standards

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: The commission rate percentage applied by the distribution channel for this booking (e.g., 15.00 for 15%). Used for commission structure analysis, channel cost benchmarking, and contract compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Channel Management; AHLA OTA Partnership Standards; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_amount
attributes.description: The per-booking connectivity or transaction fee charged by the channel technology provider (e.g., GDS segment fee, CRS transaction fee). Included in total cost-of-acquisition calculation alongside commission.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; SAP S/4HANA Finance AP Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this channel booking transaction record was first created in the Silver layer data product. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and ETL reconciliation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); SOX Section 404 (audit trail); HTNG Data Exchange Standards

attributes.name: crs_booking_reference
attributes.description: The unique booking identifier assigned by the Central Reservation System (Sabre SynXis CRS). Used for cross-system reconciliation between CRS and PMS booking records.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Central Reservations Module

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the booking was transacted by the distribution channel (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency revenue reconciliation and FX conversion in financial reporting. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP; SAP S/4HANA Finance Module

attributes.name: gds_segment_number
attributes.description: The segment identifier assigned by the Global Distribution System (GDS) for bookings originating through GDS channels (e.g., Sabre, Amadeus, Travelport). Used for GDS billing reconciliation and travel agent attribution.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG GDS Connectivity Standards

attributes.name: gross_booking_value
attributes.description: The total gross value of the booking as received from the distribution channel, inclusive of all room charges before deduction of channel commissions or fees. Expressed in the booking currency. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.
attributes.references: USALI Lodging Financial Reporting Standards; SAP S/4HANA Finance AR Module; IFRS/GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: is_cancelled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this booking has been cancelled (True = cancelled, False = active). Used for channel-level cancellation rate analysis and net booking volume reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Reservations Module; Sabre SynXis CRS; AHLA Cancellation Policy Standards

attributes.name: is_modified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this booking has been modified after initial confirmation (True = modified, False = original booking). Used to track modification rates by channel and assess channel data quality.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Reservations Module; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: is_rate_parity_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the booked rate is compliant with the rate parity agreement for this channel (True = compliant, False = parity violation detected). Critical for OTA contract compliance monitoring and channel rate parity management.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Rate Distribution; AHLA OTA Partnership Standards; EU Rate Parity Regulations

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this channel booking transaction record was last updated in the Silver layer data product. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role. Used for change data capture, incremental load processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); SOX Section 404 (audit trail); HTNG Data Exchange Standards

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of days between the booking timestamp and the check-in date. Stored as a business attribute to support lead time distribution analysis by channel, demand forecasting, and last-minute booking pattern identification.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Demand Forecasting; Infor EzRMS Demand Forecasting; STR Benchmarking Standards

attributes.name: length_of_stay_nights
attributes.description: The number of nights for the booked stay, derived from check-in and check-out dates. Stored as a business attribute to support LOS-based rate restriction analysis, minimum stay controls, and ALOS reporting without requiring date arithmetic at query time.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS LOS Controls; USALI Lodging Standards; STR Benchmarking Standards

attributes.name: net_revenue_amount
attributes.description: The net revenue retained by the property after deduction of channel commission from the gross booking value. Primary metric for channel contribution analysis and cost-of-acquisition benchmarking. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.
attributes.references: USALI Lodging Financial Reporting Standards; SAP S/4HANA Finance GL Module; IFRS/GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: number_of_guests
attributes.description: The total number of guests included in this booking. Used for occupancy analysis, per-guest revenue calculations, and channel demand pattern reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Reservations Module; USALI Lodging Standards

attributes.name: number_of_rooms
attributes.description: The number of rooms included in this booking transaction. Typically 1 for FIT (Free Independent Traveler) bookings; may be greater for group or multi-room bookings received through a channel.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Reservations Module; Sabre SynXis CRS; USALI Lodging Standards

attributes.name: ota_confirmation_number
attributes.description: The booking confirmation number assigned by the Online Travel Agency (OTA) platform (e.g., Booking.com, Expedia). Used for reconciliation with OTA partner systems and commission invoice matching.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG OTA Connectivity Standards; PCI DSS

attributes.name: pms_confirmation_number
attributes.description: The externally-communicated confirmation number generated by the Property Management System (Oracle OPERA PMS) for this booking. Serves as the primary guest-facing booking reference. BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Reservations Module; HTNG Data Exchange Standards

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rate type applied to this booking. BAR (Best Available Rate), LRA (Last Room Availability), NRR (Non-Refundable Rate), corporate, package, promotional, or group. Critical for rate parity monitoring and revenue strategy analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BAR|LRA|NRR|corporate|package|promotional|group — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Pricing Module; Sabre SynXis CRS; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: source_country
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the origin from which the booking was made through the channel. Used for geographic demand analysis, international vs. domestic channel mix reporting, and targeted marketing attribution.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Country Codes; Sabre SynXis CRS; GDPR Article 4 (geographic data)

attributes.name: travel_agent_iata_number
attributes.description: The 8-digit IATA (International Air Transport Association) accreditation number of the travel agency that made this booking. Used for travel agent commission processing, GDS attribution, and agency performance reporting.
attributes.references: IATA Travel Agency Accreditation Standards; Sabre SynXis CRS; SAP S/4HANA Finance AP Module

products.name: commission_schedule
products.description: Master and transactional records for all channel distribution costs — the single source of truth for OTA commissions, GDS segment fees, CRS transaction fees, channel manager connectivity fees, and per-booking cost accruals. Captures commission/fee structures (percentage, flat, tiered), negotiated rates per partner, applicable rate plans, effective date ranges, property scope, fee types, billing frequencies, and per-booking accrual records with amounts in local and base currency. Supports commission invoice reconciliation, AP processing, total cost-of-acquisition calculation, technology cost management, and channel profitability analysis. Encompasses all cost types previously tracked separately (connectivity fees, per-segment fees, per-transaction fees) in a unified cost management product.

attributes.name: commission_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each commission or fee schedule record in the channel distribution cost management system. Primary key for the commission_schedule data product.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Commission schedules are negotiated as part of OTA co-marketing campaigns; tracking which campaign drove specific commission structures is essential for marketing spend reconciliation, contract compli

attributes.name: campaign_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign_offer. Business justification: Promotional campaigns frequently include elevated commission incentives for OTA partners tied to specific offers. Finance and channel teams need to link commission schedules to the campaign offer that

attributes.name: channel_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel_contract. Business justification: Commission schedules define the commission terms negotiated in channel contracts with OTA partners and GDS providers. Adding nullable channel_contract_id FK links commission schedules to their governi

attributes.name: channel_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific rate plan (BAR, LRA, NRR, package, negotiated corporate) to which this commission schedule is scoped. Null indicates the schedule applies to all rate plans for the channel partner.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS — Rate Distribution; IDeaS G3 RMS — Pricing

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to guest.corporate_account. Business justification: Commission schedules are negotiated per corporate account (e.g., TMC override rates, volume-tiered commissions). Account managers and finance teams need this link to apply the correct commission sched

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Commission schedules define expense structures that must be allocated to cost centers for departmental P&L reporting, enabling accurate distribution cost analysis and budget variance tracking.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Commission schedules define fee structures for specific distribution channels. Many commission schedules per channel (e.g., tiered by volume, rate plan, market segment). Removes redundant channel_type

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Commission schedules are aligned to fiscal periods for budget vs. actual commission expense analysis. Revenue managers and finance teams use this link to evaluate channel commission costs within defin

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.market_segment. Business justification: Commission schedules are differentiated by market segment (e.g., corporate negotiated vs. leisure OTA vs. group). Proper FK enables segment-scoped commission schedule lookup and rate loading validatio

attributes.name: ota_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel partner (OTA, GDS, CRS, channel manager, direct booking engine) to which this commission or fee schedule applies. Links to the channel partner master record.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS — Channel Management; HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) Channel Standards

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific property or hotel to which this commission schedule applies. Null or a portfolio-level sentinel value indicates the schedule applies across all properties (chain-wide agreement).
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS — Property Configuration; USALI

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.room_type. Business justification: OTA and travel agent contracts frequently specify differentiated commission rates by room type (e.g., suites vs. standard rooms). A room_type_id FK on commission_schedule enables room-type-specific co

attributes.name: applies_to_cancellations
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commission or fee is still payable when a booking is cancelled (True = commission owed on cancellations, False = commission waived on cancellations). Critical for NRR (Non-Refundable Rate) commission accrual and cancellation cost management.
attributes.references: USALI — Channel Cost Classification; AHLA Distribution Cost Standards

attributes.name: applies_to_no_shows
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commission or fee is payable on no-show bookings (True = commission owed on no-shows, False = commission waived). Affects no-show revenue net-of-commission calculations and OTA contract compliance.
attributes.references: USALI — Channel Cost Classification; AHLA Distribution Cost Standards

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authorized approver (e.g., VP Revenue Management, CFO) who approved this commission schedule for execution. Required for SOX financial controls compliance and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Financial Controls; SAP S/4HANA — Procurement MM

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this commission schedule was formally approved for activation. Part of the SOX-compliant approval audit trail for financial commitments.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Financial Controls; SAP S/4HANA — Procurement MM

attributes.name: auto_accrual_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether commission and fee accruals under this schedule are automatically calculated and posted to the GL upon booking confirmation (True) or require manual accrual processing (False). Supports automated AP accrual workflows in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Finance GL/AP; USALI — Accrual Accounting; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the channel partner invoices the property for commissions or fees: monthly (most common for OTA commissions), weekly, per_booking (real-time deduction), quarterly, annual (common for connectivity subscription fees). Drives AP accrual scheduling and cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; USALI — Accounts Payable; AHLA Distribution Cost Standards

attributes.name: booking_window_max_days
attributes.description: Maximum advance booking window (in days before arrival) for which this commission schedule is applicable. Null indicates no maximum booking window restriction. Used in conjunction with booking_window_min_days for last-minute rate commission scoping.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS — Rate Distribution; IDeaS G3 RMS — Inventory Controls

attributes.name: booking_window_min_days
attributes.description: Minimum advance booking window (in days before arrival) for which this commission schedule is applicable. Used for LOS (Length of Stay) and advance purchase rate plan commission scoping. Null indicates no minimum booking window restriction.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS — Rate Distribution; IDeaS G3 RMS — Inventory Controls

attributes.name: commission_basis
attributes.description: The unit basis on which the commission or fee is calculated and accrued: per_booking (one charge per reservation), per_room_night (charge per occupied room night), per_segment (GDS per-segment charge), per_transaction (CRS per-transaction charge), per_period (fixed charge per billing period regardless of volume). Drives accrual engine logic.
attributes.references: USALI — Channel Cost Classification; GDS Industry Standards; HTNG Channel Standards

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: Negotiated commission rate expressed as a percentage of the applicable revenue base (e.g., 15.0000 = 15%). Applicable when fee_structure is 'percentage'. Represents the contractually agreed OTA or agent commission rate. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.
attributes.references: USALI — Channel Cost Classification; AHLA Distribution Cost Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this commission schedule record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; USALI

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this commission or fee schedule becomes contractually binding and applicable to bookings. Used to determine which schedule version applies to a given booking date for accrual and invoice reconciliation.
attributes.references: USALI — Contract Effective Dates; SAP S/4HANA AP Module; IFRS/GAAP — Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this commission or fee schedule expires and is no longer applicable. Null indicates an open-ended agreement with no defined expiry. Used for schedule versioning and contract renewal tracking.
attributes.references: USALI — Contract Effective Dates; SAP S/4HANA AP Module

attributes.name: fee_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the flat fee or tiered threshold amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency AP reconciliation and cost-of-acquisition reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP — Foreign Currency Transactions

attributes.name: fee_structure
attributes.description: Defines how the commission or fee is calculated: percentage (applied as a % of booking revenue or room revenue), flat (fixed monetary amount per booking or period), tiered (rate varies by volume or revenue thresholds), per_unit (fixed amount per room-night, segment, or transaction unit). Determines the accrual calculation method.
attributes.references: USALI — Cost of Acquisition; SAP S/4HANA AP Module

attributes.name: fee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost type captured by this schedule: commission (percentage of booking revenue paid to OTA/agent), per_segment_fee (GDS per-segment charge), per_transaction_fee (CRS per-booking transaction fee), connectivity_fee (channel manager or switch connectivity charge), subscription_fee (fixed periodic platform fee), override_commission (negotiated override above standard rate). Drives AP coding and cost-of-acquisition (COA) categorization.
attributes.references: USALI — Channel Cost Classification; HTNG Channel Standards; GDS Industry Standards (IATA/ARC)

attributes.name: flat_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monetary fee amount per booking, segment, transaction, or billing period, expressed in the schedule currency. Applicable when fee_structure is 'flat' or 'per_unit'. Used for GDS per-segment fees, CRS per-transaction fees, and connectivity subscription fees. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.
attributes.references: USALI — Channel Cost Classification; SAP S/4HANA AP Module

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger account code in SAP S/4HANA to which commission and fee expenses are posted for financial reporting under USALI. Ensures correct P&L classification of distribution costs (e.g., OTA commission expense, GDS fee expense) per USALI departmental accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Finance GL; USALI — Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: los_min_nights
attributes.description: Minimum Length of Stay (LOS) in nights required for this commission schedule to apply. Null indicates no LOS restriction. Supports commission scoping for extended-stay or minimum-stay rate plans.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Inventory Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS — Rate Distribution; USALI

attributes.name: max_commission_amount
attributes.description: Contractual cap on the commission or fee amount payable per booking or per billing period. Applicable for schedules with a commission ceiling clause. Expressed in fee_currency_code. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.
attributes.references: USALI — Channel Cost Classification; SAP S/4HANA AP Module

attributes.name: min_commission_amount
attributes.description: Contractual minimum commission or fee amount payable per booking or per billing period, regardless of the calculated percentage amount. Applicable for schedules with a commission floor clause. Expressed in fee_currency_code. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.
attributes.references: USALI — Channel Cost Classification; SAP S/4HANA AP Module

attributes.name: negotiated_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal team or individual (e.g., Revenue Management, Channel Distribution, Procurement) responsible for negotiating this commission schedule. Used for accountability tracking and contract ownership.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Procurement MM; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Financial Controls

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, special contractual conditions, negotiation history notes, or exceptions associated with this commission schedule. Not used for structured data; intended for operational reference by Revenue Management and AP teams.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice receipt within which payment to the channel partner is due (e.g., 30 = Net 30). Used in AP aging analysis and cash flow management per SAP S/4HANA payment terms configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; IFRS/GAAP — Accounts Payable; USALI

attributes.name: rate_parity_monitored
attributes.description: Indicates whether rate parity compliance is contractually required and actively monitored for bookings under this commission schedule (True = rate parity clause in effect). Supports rate parity monitoring workflows and OTA contract compliance management.
attributes.references: AHLA Distribution Cost Standards; HTNG Channel Standards; EU Rate Parity Regulations

attributes.name: revenue_base
attributes.description: Defines the revenue component on which the commission percentage is calculated: room_revenue (room charges only), total_revenue (all charges including F&B and ancillaries), net_revenue (after discounts and taxes), gross_revenue (before deductions), f_and_b_revenue (food and beverage charges only). Critical for accurate commission accrual and invoice reconciliation.
attributes.references: USALI — Revenue Classification; AHLA Distribution Cost Standards

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this commission or fee schedule, used in AP reconciliation, contract references, and channel partner communications (e.g., OTA-EXP-COMM-2024, GDS-SAB-SEG-FEE).
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS — Channel Management; SAP S/4HANA AP Module

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the commission or fee schedule, used in reporting dashboards, AP workflows, and channel profitability analysis (e.g., 'Expedia Standard OTA Commission FY2024', 'Sabre GDS Per-Segment Fee Q1 2024').
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the commission schedule: active (currently in force), inactive (temporarily suspended), pending (approved but not yet effective), expired (past effective_until date), terminated (cancelled before expiry), draft (under negotiation, not yet approved). Drives AP processing eligibility and accrual inclusion.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; USALI — Channel Cost Management

attributes.name: tier_1_rate_pct
attributes.description: Commission rate percentage applicable when booking volume or revenue falls within the Tier 1 threshold band in a tiered fee structure. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.
attributes.references: USALI — Channel Cost Classification; AHLA Distribution Cost Standards

attributes.name: tier_1_threshold
attributes.description: Lower volume or revenue threshold (in booking count or currency amount) that triggers the Tier 1 commission or fee rate in a tiered fee structure. Applicable when fee_structure is 'tiered'. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.
attributes.references: USALI — Channel Cost Classification; SAP S/4HANA AP Module

attributes.name: tier_2_rate_pct
attributes.description: Commission rate percentage applicable when booking volume or revenue falls within the Tier 2 threshold band in a tiered fee structure. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.
attributes.references: USALI — Channel Cost Classification; AHLA Distribution Cost Standards

attributes.name: tier_2_threshold
attributes.description: Upper volume or revenue threshold that triggers the Tier 2 commission or fee rate in a tiered fee structure. Applicable when fee_structure is 'tiered'. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.
attributes.references: USALI — Channel Cost Classification; SAP S/4HANA AP Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this commission schedule record was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

products.name: commission_accrual
products.description: Transactional records of commission amounts accrued per booking for each distribution channel. Captures booking reference, channel, OTA partner, stay date, commission schedule applied, gross booking value, commission rate, commission amount in local and base currency, accrual date, and payment status. Feeds into finance AP for commission invoice reconciliation and channel cost-of-acquisition reporting.
products.reference: OTA Commission Accrual / USALI Channel Cost

attributes.name: commission_accrual_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each commission accrual record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this transactional entity. ROLE: TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ar_invoice. Business justification: Commission accruals need to link to AR invoices for revenue recognition and reconciliation. When commissions are invoiced to OTA partners, this FK tracks the billing document. This is a standard finan

attributes.name: booking_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.booking_source. Business justification: Commission accruals are tracked by booking source for cost-of-acquisition analysis and channel attribution. Many accruals per booking source. Removes redundant booking_source_code which can be retriev

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel through which the booking was made (e.g., OTA, GDS, direct web, voice). Links to the channel master in the channel domain for channel mix and cost-of-acquisition reporting.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation / AHLA Technology)

attributes.name: channel_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel_rate_plan. Business justification: Commission rates vary by channel rate plan. The commission_accrual table has rate_plan_code (STRING) which should be normalized to channel_rate_plan via FK. This links commission accruals to the speci

attributes.name: commission_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commission schedule or rate agreement applied to this accrual record. Determines the applicable commission rate tier, calculation method, and contractual terms with the OTA or GDS partner.

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to guest.corporate_account. Business justification: Corporate bookings generate commissions that must be attributed to the corporate account for AR reconciliation, account performance reporting, and annual room-night target tracking. Finance and accoun

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Commission accruals are distribution expenses requiring cost center allocation for accurate departmental financial statements, enabling proper matching of channel costs to revenue per USALI reporting

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Commission accruals must be posted to the correct fiscal period for USALI-compliant P&L reporting and period-end close. Finance controllers use this link to produce period-accurate commission expense

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.market_segment. Business justification: Commission cost-of-acquisition analysis by market segment is a standard revenue management report. Linking accruals to market_segment enables segment-level distribution cost benchmarking and USALI-com

attributes.name: negotiated_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.revenue_negotiated_rate. Business justification: Negotiated rates carry specific commission terms (commission_pct, iata_number). Linking commission_accrual to revenue_negotiated_rate enables verification that accrued commissions match the contracted

attributes.name: ota_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the OTA or GDS partner entity responsible for the booking. Populated when the channel type is OTA or GDS; null for direct bookings. Supports OTA partnership performance and commission reconciliation reporting.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hotel or resort property for which the commission is being accrued. Enables property-level commission cost reporting and CPOR (Cost Per Occupied Room) analysis.

attributes.name: reservation_booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.reservation_booking. Business justification: Commission accruals must link directly to reservations for reconciliation, dispute resolution, cancellation-driven commission reversals, and complete audit trail from booking to financial posting. Cur

attributes.name: accrual_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the commission liability was recognized in the general ledger. Aligns with USALI period-end accrual practices and SAP S/4HANA GL posting date. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.

attributes.name: accrual_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the commission accrual record. Drives AP (Accounts Payable) workflow in SAP S/4HANA: 'accrued' = liability recognized; 'invoiced' = OTA invoice received; 'paid' = payment disbursed; 'disputed' = under reconciliation review; 'cancelled' = booking cancelled before stay; 'reversed' = accrual reversed due to no-show or refund. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.

attributes.name: adr
attributes.description: The Average Daily Rate of the booking, calculated as gross_booking_value divided by room_nights. Stored for channel performance benchmarking and to support STR STAR Report comparisons without requiring recalculation from source.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reservation was cancelled, if applicable. When populated, triggers commission accrual reversal logic per the cancellation policy terms. Null for active or completed bookings.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; USALI; SAP S/4HANA AP

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution channel through which the booking originated. Drives commission rate tier selection and channel mix reporting. OTA = Online Travel Agency (e.g., Expedia, Booking.com); GDS = Global Distribution System (e.g., Sabre, Amadeus); direct_web = brand.com; voice = call center; corporate = negotiated corporate account; wholesale = tour operator/wholesaler.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG / AHLA Technology; AHLA

attributes.name: commission_amount_base
attributes.description: The commission amount converted to the company's functional base currency (typically USD) for consolidated financial reporting and USALI-compliant P&L statements. Enables cross-property and cross-currency commission cost analysis. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: USALI; SAP S/4HANA GL; GAAP/IFRS; IFRS 21

attributes.name: commission_amount_local
attributes.description: The calculated commission amount payable to the distribution channel partner in the local transaction currency (gross_booking_value × commission_rate). Used for OTA invoice reconciliation and AP liability posting. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET.

attributes.name: commission_basis
attributes.description: Defines the revenue base on which the commission rate is applied: 'room_revenue' = room charges only; 'total_revenue' = all charges including F&B and ancillary; 'net_revenue' = revenue net of taxes and fees; 'flat_fee' = fixed amount per booking regardless of revenue.

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: The contractual commission rate applied to the gross booking value, expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.15 = 15%). Sourced from the applicable commission schedule. Used to calculate the commission amount and for rate parity and cost-of-acquisition analysis.

attributes.name: commission_type
attributes.description: Classification of the commission arrangement: 'standard' = default contractual rate; 'override' = manually overridden rate approved by revenue management; 'promotional' = time-limited promotional rate; 'group' = group booking commission; 'negotiated' = bilaterally negotiated rate outside standard schedule.

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_amount
attributes.description: The GDS or channel connectivity fee charged by the distribution technology provider (e.g., Sabre SynXis transaction fee) associated with this booking, in local currency. Included in total cost-of-acquisition (CoA) reporting alongside commission.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; USALI; SAP S/4HANA AP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commission accrual record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail and SOX financial controls compliance. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.

attributes.name: dispute_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing the nature of a commission dispute with the OTA or GDS partner. Populated when accrual_status is 'disputed'. Supports the channel dispute resolution workflow and AP reconciliation process.

attributes.name: fx_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert the local currency commission amount to the base currency at the time of accrual. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA treasury rates. Required for accurate multi-currency financial reporting and audit trail.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA GL account code to which the commission expense is posted (e.g., USALI Schedule 6 - Sales and Marketing / Distribution Costs). Ensures correct financial statement classification per USALI and GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA GL; USALI; GAAP/IFRS; SOX

attributes.name: gross_booking_value
attributes.description: The total gross booking value of the reservation on which commission is calculated, in the local transaction currency. Represents the full room revenue amount before any discounts or adjustments. Forms the base for commission rate application. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: USALI; SAP S/4HANA AP; PCI DSS

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date on the commission invoice received from the OTA or GDS partner. Used for AP aging analysis, payment due date calculation, and period-end accrual reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The OTA or GDS partner's invoice reference number received for commission payment. Used to match accrued commission liabilities against received invoices in SAP S/4HANA AP for three-way reconciliation. Null until invoice is received.

attributes.name: is_commissionable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the booking is eligible for commission payment (True) or is a non-commissionable booking (False), such as direct loyalty redemptions, staff rates, or complimentary stays. Drives commission accrual logic and AP posting.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; AHLA

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction currency in which the booking was made and commission is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency commission reconciliation and FX conversion. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the commission payment was disbursed to the OTA or GDS partner. Populated when accrual_status transitions to 'paid'. Used for AP reconciliation and cash flow reporting.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The contractual due date by which the commission payment must be disbursed to the OTA or GDS partner per the commission schedule terms. Used for AP cash flow planning and SLA compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: The payment transaction reference or bank transfer reference number from SAP S/4HANA AP when the commission is disbursed. Enables end-to-end traceability from accrual to cash payment for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP; SOX; PCI DSS

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: The reason code for reversing a previously accrued commission. Populated when accrual_status is 'reversed' or 'cancelled'. Supports AP reconciliation and channel dispute management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cancellation|no_show|rate_correction|duplicate|dispute_resolved|other — promote to reference product if additional values are needed]

attributes.name: room_nights
attributes.description: The number of room nights associated with the booking for which commission is being accrued. Used to calculate CPOR (Cost Per Occupied Room) and to normalize commission costs across bookings of varying LOS (Length of Stay).
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; USALI; STR (Smith Travel Research)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this commission accrual record originated: 'OPERA_PMS' = Oracle OPERA PMS cashiering module; 'SYNXIS_CRS' = Sabre SynXis CRS channel management; 'SAP_AP' = SAP S/4HANA AP accrual; 'MANUAL' = manually entered adjustment. Supports data lineage and ETL audit.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; SAP S/4HANA; HTNG / AHLA Technology

attributes.name: total_cost_of_acquisition
attributes.description: The total distribution cost for this booking, combining commission_amount_local and connectivity_fee_amount. Represents the all-in cost of acquiring the booking through this channel. Used for channel profitability and net RevPAR analysis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this commission accrual record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, reconciliation audit trails, and SOX financial controls. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.

products.name: channel_contract
products.description: Master records for commercial contracts with OTA partners and GDS providers, capturing contract type, effective and expiration dates, contracted commission rates, rate parity clauses, last-room-availability (LRA) obligations, preferred partner program terms, marketing co-op commitments, and dispute resolution terms. Distinct from commission_schedule (which captures the rate structure) — this is the legal agreement record.

attributes.name: channel_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the channel contract record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: HTNG Data Standards; SAP S/4HANA Contract Management

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel (OTA, GDS, direct, etc.) that is party to this contract.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Channel Management; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to guest.corporate_account. Business justification: Channel contracts are frequently negotiated on behalf of a corporate account (e.g., TMC master agreement, corporate GDS contract). Linking channel_contract to corporate_account enables contract compli

attributes.name: gds_connection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.gds_connection. Business justification: Channel contracts may reference specific GDS connection configurations, particularly for chain-level GDS agreements that are implemented at the property connection level. Many contracts per GDS connec

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Channel contracts create financial obligations requiring GL account assignment for proper revenue/expense recognition, audit trail compliance, and financial statement preparation per accounting standa

attributes.name: ota_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.ota_partner. Business justification: Channel contracts are commercial agreements signed with OTA partners, defining commission rates, rate parity obligations, and terms. Many contracts per OTA partner (e.g., master agreement, property-sp

attributes.name: ownership_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.ownership_entity. Business justification: Legal contract counterparty process: in ownership-managed hotel structures, the ownership entity (not the operating property) is the legal signatory on channel distribution contracts. Finance and lega

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property or portfolio of properties covered by this contract. Null if the contract applies at the brand or enterprise level.

attributes.name: bar_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel is contractually entitled to receive the Best Available Rate (BAR) as defined in the Revenue Management System. Drives rate loading rules in Sabre SynXis CRS.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the contracted cancellation and no-show policy applicable to bookings made through this channel (e.g., '24H', '48H', 'NON_REF'). Loaded into Oracle OPERA PMS and Sabre SynXis CRS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; AHLA

attributes.name: commission_basis
attributes.description: Defines the revenue base on which the commission rate is applied: net rate (after discounts), gross rate (before discounts), room revenue only, or total revenue including F&B and ancillaries.
attributes.references: USALI; AHLA Distribution Standards; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: Base commission rate (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.1500 = 15%) payable to the channel partner per confirmed booking under this contract. Distinct from the commission_schedule product which captures tiered or conditional rate structures.
attributes.references: USALI; SAP S/4HANA AP; AHLA Distribution Standards

attributes.name: connectivity_fee
attributes.description: Fixed or per-transaction fee charged by the channel or GDS for technical connectivity and distribution services. Distinct from commission which is percentage-based. Used in cost-of-acquisition (COA) analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP; USALI; HTNG Connectivity Standards

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_type
attributes.description: Specifies how the connectivity fee is structured: per booking transaction, per GDS segment, annual flat fee, or monthly flat fee.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; HTNG; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: content_requirements
attributes.description: Free-text description of contractual obligations regarding property content (images, descriptions, amenities) that must be maintained on the channel platform, including minimum image counts, refresh frequency, and accuracy standards.
attributes.references: AHLA Distribution Standards; HTNG Content Standards

attributes.name: contract_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the contract (e.g., 'Expedia 2025 Master Distribution Agreement — Americas').

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known legal contract reference number assigned by the contracting parties or the legal department. Used for correspondence, audits, and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Contract Management; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the contract. Drives whether the channel is eligible to receive inventory and rates via the CRS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Contract Management; AHLA Technology (HTNG)

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the commercial agreement by channel category. Determines applicable commission structures, rate parity obligations, and connectivity requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ota_distribution|gds_participation|direct_connect|wholesale|bed_bank|metasearch|corporate_negotiated — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AHLA Distribution Standards; Sabre SynXis CRS Channel Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contract record was first created in the system of record. Used for audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5(e); SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary values in this contract are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: data_sharing_agreement
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract includes a data sharing or data processing agreement governing the exchange of guest and booking data with the channel partner. Required for GDPR Article 28 compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 28; CCPA; PCI DSS; AHLA Data Privacy Standards

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_jurisdiction
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the legal jurisdiction governing dispute resolution and contract interpretation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Contract Management; IFRS; GDPR Article 79

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_mechanism
attributes.description: Contractually agreed mechanism for resolving commercial disputes between the hotel and the channel partner.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Contract Management; AHLA Legal Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract becomes legally binding and the channel is authorized to distribute inventory. Aligns with USALI period reporting.
attributes.references: USALI; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract ceases to be binding. Null for evergreen contracts. Used to trigger renewal workflows and rate parity audits.
attributes.references: USALI; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA Contract Management

attributes.name: gdpr_dpa_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Data Processing Agreement (DPA) Reference
attributes.description: Reference number or document identifier for the GDPR Data Processing Agreement (DPA) executed with the channel partner. Mandatory for EU-based OTA and GDS partnerships under GDPR Article 28.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 28; CCPA; AHLA Data Privacy

attributes.name: invoice_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which commission invoices or settlement statements are issued between the hotel and the channel partner.

attributes.name: lra_obligation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract includes a Last Room Availability (LRA) obligation, requiring the hotel to make the last available room accessible to this channel even when inventory is restricted for other channels.
attributes.references: AHLA Distribution Standards; Sabre SynXis CRS; IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls

attributes.name: marketing_coop_amount
attributes.description: Annual or contract-period monetary commitment for co-operative marketing spend with the channel partner (e.g., sponsored listings, display advertising on OTA platform). Expressed in the contract currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; USALI Marketing Expense; AHLA

attributes.name: nrr_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract permits the hotel to offer Non-Refundable Rates (NRR) through this channel. Relevant for revenue management strategy and cancellation policy governance.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; AHLA

attributes.name: payment_model
attributes.description: Commercial payment model governing how the channel collects and remits payment: merchant model (channel collects from guest and remits net), agency model (hotel collects and pays commission), net rate (channel marks up a net rate), or wholesale.
attributes.references: USALI; SAP S/4HANA AR/AP; AHLA Distribution Standards

attributes.name: pci_compliance_confirmed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Card Industry (PCI) Compliance Confirmed Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel partner has confirmed PCI DSS compliance as required by the contract terms for handling payment card data.

attributes.name: preferred_partner_tier
attributes.description: Tier designation within the OTA or GDS preferred partner program (e.g., Expedia Preferred Plus, Booking.com Preferred). Higher tiers typically confer better placement, lower commission rates, or co-op marketing benefits.
attributes.references: AHLA; Sabre SynXis CRS Partner Programs

attributes.name: rate_parity_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract includes a rate parity obligation requiring the hotel to offer the channel the same or better rates as other distribution channels. Critical for revenue management compliance and OTA relationship governance.
attributes.references: AHLA; EU Competition Law (rate parity regulations); IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: rate_parity_type
attributes.description: Specifies the scope of the rate parity obligation: broad parity (match all channels including direct), narrow parity (match only other OTAs, not direct), or no parity obligation. Reflects EU regulatory distinctions post-2015 investigations.
attributes.references: EU Competition Law; AHLA; IDeaS G3 RMS Rate Strategy

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days prior to expiration_date by which either party must provide written notice of intent to renew or terminate. Drives automated contract renewal alerts.

attributes.name: renewal_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether the contract auto-renews at expiration, requires manual renegotiation, or is a one-time non-renewable agreement.

attributes.name: signed_date
attributes.description: Date on which all parties executed the contract. Used for legal audit trails and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SAP S/4HANA Contract Management

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this contract record was ingested into the lakehouse (e.g., SAP S/4HANA Contract Management, Sabre SynXis CRS, Oracle OPERA PMS, or manually entered).
attributes.references: HTNG Data Integration Standards; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date the contract was terminated early, if applicable. Distinct from expiration_date which is the scheduled end. Populated only when contract_status is 'terminated'.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this contract record. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the lakehouse ETL pipeline and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5(e); SAP S/4HANA

products.name: stop_sell
products.description: Transactional records of stop-sell, close-out, and restriction controls applied to specific channels, room types, and date ranges. Captures channel, property, room type, stay date range, restriction type (stop-sell, minimum LOS, closed to arrival, closed to departure), reason code, applied-by user, effective timestamp, and lift timestamp. Supports revenue management inventory control actions executed through the CRS and channel manager to optimize channel mix and protect direct booking rates.

attributes.name: stop_sell_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each channel stop-sell, close-out, or restriction control record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this transactional entity.
attributes.references: HTNG Data Dictionary; Sabre SynXis CRS Data Model

attributes.name: booking_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.booking_source. Business justification: Stop-sell restrictions can be applied to specific booking sources within a channel for granular inventory control. While stop_sell already has channel_id for channel-level restrictions, adding nullabl

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution channel (OTA, GDS, direct web, voice, etc.) to which this stop-sell restriction is applied. Links to the channel master record.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Channel Management; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: channel_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the rate plan (BAR, NRR, LRA, package, etc.) to which this restriction is scoped. Null indicates the restriction applies across all rate plans for the channel and room type combination.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Rate Plan Configuration; Sabre SynXis CRS Rate Distribution

attributes.name: inventory_control_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.inventory_control. Business justification: Stop-sell actions are triggered by inventory_control records (hurdle rates exceeded, overbooking caps reached, sell limits hit). FK links the channel-level stop-sell action to the revenue-side invento

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.market_segment. Business justification: Stop-sell restrictions are segment-specific in revenue management — closing OTA transient while keeping corporate open is a standard tactic. FK enables segment-scoped restriction audit and RMS-driven

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hotel or resort property to which this stop-sell restriction applies. Links to the property master record in the Property domain.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Property Configuration; AHLA Property Standards

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific room type (e.g., King Deluxe, Double Standard) subject to the stop-sell restriction. Null indicates the restriction applies to all room types at the property.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Room Type Configuration; HTNG Room Type Standards

attributes.name: strategy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.strategy. Business justification: Stop-sell actions are tactical executions of revenue strategies (closing channels when demand exceeds forecast thresholds). FK links each stop-sell to the governing strategy, enabling strategy-level a

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Type of inventory control action recorded in this transaction. apply: restriction manually applied; lift: restriction manually removed; modify: restriction parameters changed; auto_apply: restriction applied by RMS automation rule; auto_lift: restriction lifted by RMS automation rule.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS Channel Management

attributes.name: adr_at_apply
attributes.description: Average Daily Rate (ADR) for the affected room type and date range at the time the restriction was applied. Provides revenue management context for the stop-sell decision and supports yield optimization analysis.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS ADR Metrics; STR STAR Report ADR Benchmarking; USALI

attributes.name: applied_by_user
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the revenue management or channel management user who applied this restriction. Supports accountability and audit trail for inventory control actions.

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this restriction action required managerial approval before being applied. Supports internal control workflows and SOX compliance for material inventory control decisions.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 (internal controls); AHLA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: approved_by_user
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the manager or supervisor who approved this restriction action when approval_required is True. Null if no approval was required or if the action was system-generated.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the restriction action was approved by the designated manager or supervisor. Null if no approval was required. Supports SOX audit trail for material inventory control decisions.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 (internal controls); AHLA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: channel_manager_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier assigned by the channel manager or connectivity platform (e.g., SiteMinder, Amadeus Central Reservations) when the restriction was transmitted to the distribution channel. Supports cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Channel Manager Integration; HTNG Channel Connectivity Standards

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the distribution channel. ota: Online Travel Agency (OTA); gds: Global Distribution System (GDS); direct: brand.com or direct booking; voice: call center or CRS voice; wholesaler: tour operator or bed bank; metasearch: Google Hotels, Trivago; corporate: negotiated corporate accounts; group: group/MICE bookings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ota|gds|direct|voice|wholesaler|metasearch|corporate|group — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Channel Types; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; STR Channel Mix Benchmarking

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this stop-sell restriction record was first captured in the system. Distinct from effective_timestamp which records when the restriction became operationally active.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); SOX Section 404 (audit trail)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the ADR and any monetary values recorded in this restriction record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency property operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP Multi-Currency Reporting; USALI

attributes.name: days_out
attributes.description: Number of days between the date the restriction was applied and the first affected stay date (stay_date_from). Represents the booking window horizon at which the restriction was enacted, used for revenue strategy analysis.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Pickup Analysis; Infor EzRMS Demand Forecasting; STR Benchmarking

attributes.name: effective_timestamp
attributes.description: The real-world date and time when this restriction became active and was enforced across the channel. This is the principal business event timestamp for this transactional record, distinct from the audit creation timestamp.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Inventory Control Activation; HTNG Inventory Control Standards

attributes.name: is_all_channels
attributes.description: Indicates whether this restriction applies to all distribution channels simultaneously rather than a single specific channel. True when a property-wide close-out is executed across all channels; False when scoped to a specific channel.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Global Inventory Controls; IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls

attributes.name: is_all_room_types
attributes.description: Indicates whether this restriction applies to all room types at the property rather than a specific room type. True when the restriction is property-wide across all room categories.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Inventory Controls; Oracle OPERA PMS Room Type Configuration

attributes.name: is_system_generated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this restriction was automatically generated by the Revenue Management System (RMS) or channel manager automation rule, as opposed to being manually applied by a revenue manager.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Automation Rules; Infor EzRMS Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: lift_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business reason for lifting the restriction. Examples: DEMAND_SOFTENED, RATE_PARITY_RESTORED, MANUAL_OVERRIDE, SCHEDULED_EXPIRY, CHANNEL_RENEGOTIATED. Null if restriction has not been lifted. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DEMAND_SOFTENED|RATE_PARITY_RESTORED|MANUAL_OVERRIDE|SCHEDULED_EXPIRY|CHANNEL_RENEGOTIATED|SYSTEM_AUTO — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: lift_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the restriction was lifted or removed, re-opening inventory on the affected channel. Null if the restriction is still active or has not yet been lifted.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Inventory Control Lift; IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls

attributes.name: lifted_by_user
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the user who lifted or removed this restriction. Null if the restriction has not been lifted or was lifted automatically by the system.

attributes.name: max_los
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights a guest is permitted to stay when booking on this channel during the restricted date range. Applicable when restriction_type is max_los. Null for non-LOS restriction types.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS LOS Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS LOS Restrictions; HTNG Inventory Control Standards

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights a guest must stay to be eligible for booking on this channel during the restricted date range. Applicable when restriction_type is min_los. Null for non-LOS restriction types.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS LOS Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS LOS Restrictions; HTNG Inventory Control Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments entered by the revenue manager or channel manager regarding this restriction. May include context about competitive positioning, demand events, or channel negotiation details.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: occupancy_at_apply
attributes.description: Property or room-type occupancy percentage at the time the restriction was applied. Provides context for the revenue management decision and supports post-hoc analysis of restriction effectiveness. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 85.50 = 85.50%).
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Occupancy Metrics; STR STAR Report OCC Benchmarking; USALI

attributes.name: rate_parity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stop-sell action was triggered by a rate parity breach on the affected channel. True when the restriction is applied to enforce rate parity compliance across distribution channels.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Rate Parity Monitoring; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; OTA Rate Parity Agreements

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business reason for applying the stop-sell or restriction. Examples include: HIGH_DEMAND, RATE_PARITY_BREACH, CHANNEL_PERFORMANCE, OVERBOOKING_PROTECTION, RENOVATION, ALLOTMENT_EXHAUSTED. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HIGH_DEMAND|RATE_PARITY_BREACH|CHANNEL_PERFORMANCE|OVERBOOKING_PROTECTION|RENOVATION|ALLOTMENT_EXHAUSTED|SYSTEM_AUTO — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS Restriction Reason Codes

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context or justification for the restriction beyond the standardized reason code. Entered by the revenue manager or channel manager at the time of action.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: restriction_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days spanned by the restriction date range (stay_date_to minus stay_date_from + 1). Supports analysis of restriction scope and revenue impact assessment.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: restriction_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this stop-sell or restriction control action, as generated by the CRS (Sabre SynXis) or channel manager. Used for cross-system traceability and audit reconciliation.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Inventory Control Reference; HTNG Inventory Control Standards

attributes.name: restriction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the stop-sell or restriction control record. active: restriction is currently enforced; lifted: restriction has been removed; pending: restriction is queued for activation; cancelled: restriction was voided before activation; expired: restriction passed its scheduled end without explicit lift.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Inventory Control Lifecycle; IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inventory restriction being applied to the channel. stop_sell: no new bookings accepted; closed_to_arrival (CTA): no check-ins on the stay date; closed_to_departure (CTD): no check-outs on the stay date; min_los: minimum Length of Stay (LOS) required; max_los: maximum LOS allowed; close_out: full inventory closure.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS Restriction Types; HTNG Inventory Control Standards

attributes.name: revpar_at_apply
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) at Apply
attributes.description: Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) for the affected property or room type at the time the restriction was applied. Key revenue management KPI used to contextualize the stop-sell decision and evaluate channel mix optimization outcomes.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS RevPAR Metrics; STR STAR Report RevPAR Benchmarking; USALI

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record that originated this stop-sell or restriction control action. Identifies whether the action was initiated from the CRS (Sabre SynXis), RMS (IDeaS G3), PMS (Oracle OPERA), demand forecasting system (Infor EzRMS), or entered manually.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; IDeaS G3 RMS; Oracle OPERA PMS; Infor EzRMS; HTNG Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: stay_date_from
attributes.description: First stay date (inclusive) in the date range to which this restriction applies. Represents the beginning of the affected inventory window in the property calendar.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Date Range Controls; IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls

attributes.name: stay_date_to
attributes.description: Last stay date (inclusive) in the date range to which this restriction applies. Represents the end of the affected inventory window in the property calendar.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Date Range Controls; IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls

attributes.name: transmission_status
attributes.description: Status of the restriction transmission to the distribution channel via the CRS or channel manager. pending: queued for transmission; transmitted: sent to channel; confirmed: acknowledged by channel; failed: transmission error; retrying: re-attempting after failure. Critical for ensuring inventory control actions are successfully propagated.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS API Integration; HTNG Channel Connectivity Standards; SLA Compliance

attributes.name: transmission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the restriction was successfully transmitted to the distribution channel via the CRS or channel manager. Null if transmission is pending or failed. Supports SLA monitoring for inventory control propagation.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS API Integration; HTNG Channel Connectivity Standards; SLA Compliance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording the most recent modification to this restriction record, such as a status change, date range extension, or reason code update.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); SOX Section 404 (audit trail)

domains.name: event
domains.description: MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, Exhibitions) sales and operations lifecycle including event inquiries, proposals, contracts, BEO (Banquet Event Order) management, group room blocks, function space allocation, catering orders, and post-event billing. Integrates with Delphi by Amadeus. Tracks event revenue, function space utilization, group pace, and group ADR contribution.
domains.references: AHLA MICE and Event Management Best Practices

products.name: account
products.description: Master record for the corporate, association, or group client account that books MICE events. Captures organization name, industry vertical, account tier, primary and secondary contacts, credit terms, preferred properties, historical event spend, and assigned account/sales manager. Serves as the B2B client identity anchor for the event domain — distinct from the guest domain's individual traveler profile and from the finance domain's AR customer record. All inquiries, proposals, bookings, and revenue link to this entity for relationship management, account-level performance reporting, and sales territory assignment.

products.name: event_booking
products.description: Confirmed or tentative event booking representing a MICE engagement at a specific property. Acts as the master transactional record tying together all sub-components: group room blocks, function space allocations, BEOs, contracts, invoices, revenue, and attendee registrations. Captures event name, MICE category, contracted dates, total contracted value, deposit schedule, cancellation terms, attrition clauses, cutoff dates, booking status lifecycle (tentative, definite, cancelled, completed, lost) with status change history, owning sales manager, event coordinator, concession tracking, and commission details. Absorbs status audit trail, concession management, and commission tracking as embedded attributes rather than separate entities. The central hub entity for all event operations, reporting, and cross-domain integration with workforce (staffing assignments) and finance (AR posting).

products.name: invoice
products.description: Post-event invoice issued to the event client for all charges incurred during the event. Captures the invoice date, invoice number, billing period, itemized charges by category (room revenue, F&B revenue, space rental, AV, miscellaneous), applicable taxes and service charges, total amount due, payment due date, and invoice status (draft, issued, paid, disputed). Reconciles against the event_account credit terms and BEO actuals. This is the event-domain billing document — actual AR ledger posting, payment receipt, and collections are owned by the finance domain. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA AR for financial posting via cross-domain FK.

products.name: event_revenue
products.description: Transactional record of actual revenue recognized from an event booking, broken down by revenue category per USALI standards (rooms, food, beverage, space rental, AV, other). Captures the revenue date, revenue category, actual amount, budgeted amount, variance, RevPAR contribution from group rooms, and posting reference to the general ledger. This is the event-domain revenue fact — the authoritative GL journal entries and period-close revenue recognition are owned by the finance domain. Enables event revenue performance tracking, group ADR contribution analysis, and TRevPAR impact assessment. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS and SAP S/4HANA GL.

products.description: Record of an individual registered attendee for a specific event booking, supporting both in-person and virtual/hybrid participation modes. Captures the attendee name, organization, title, registration date, registration type (delegate, speaker, VIP, staff, virtual-remote), attendance mode (in-person, virtual, hybrid), dietary restrictions, accessibility requirements, room reservation linkage, badge number, check-in status, session selections, and virtual platform access credentials where applicable. Enables attendance management, rooming list coordination with the group block, capacity compliance, and post-event satisfaction tracking via Medallia.
