products.name: beo_attendance
products.description: This association product represents the Function Attendance event between an attendee and a specific Banquet Event Order (BEO) function. It captures the operational record of an individual attendee's participation in a specific event function, including per-function check-in status, meal selection, and seat assignment. Each record links one attendee to one BEO function with attributes that exist only in the context of this attendee-function participation — enabling accurate catering guarantee management, safety compliance headcounts, and post-event billing reconciliation.. Existence Justification: In MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, Exhibitions) hotel operations, an attendee participates in multiple BEO functions (e.g., welcome reception, breakout session, gala dinner) and each BEO function has multiple attendees. This is a genuine operational M:N: catering teams must know per-function headcounts for food production guarantees, and event operations teams track per-function check-in for safety compliance and post-event billing. The relationship is actively managed by event staff who create, update, and delete function attendance records throughout the event lifecycle.

attributes.name: dietary_restrictions

Critical for food safety and guest satisfaction. [Moved from beo: The BEO's dietary_restrictions field is an aggregate summary of all attendee dietary needs for catering planning. The per-attendee dietary restriction already lives on the attendee product. The BEO-level field is a derived aggregate and should be computed from attendee records rather than stored redundantly on the BEO. If per-function dietary overrides are needed, they belong on the beo_attendance association.]

Active items are currently available, seasonal items are available during specific periods, inactive items are temporarily unavailable, discontinued items are permanently removed, and pending items are awaiting approval.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS Item Master

attributes.name: item_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed classification within the item category. Examples: appetizer, entrée, dessert, cocktail, wine, beer, non-alcoholic, side dish, condiment. Used for menu organization and sales analysis.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) F&B Departmental Reporting

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this menu item record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: menu_section
attributes.description: The section or grouping on the menu where this item appears (e.g., Starters, Main Courses, Desserts, Signature Cocktails, Wine List). Used for menu layout and guest navigation.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS Menu Configuration

attributes.name: minimum_age_requirement
attributes.description: The minimum age required to purchase this menu item, typically applicable to alcoholic beverages. Null for items with no age restriction. Used for Point of Sale (POS) age verification prompts.
attributes.references: Local Alcohol Licensing Regulations / Age Verification Laws

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who last modified this menu item record. Used for accountability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: portion_size
attributes.description: The standard serving size or portion measurement for the menu item (e.g., 8 oz, 250 ml, 1 piece, serves 2). Used for consistency, cost control, and nutritional disclosure.

attributes.name: preparation_time_minutes
attributes.description: The standard time in minutes required to prepare and serve this menu item from order placement to guest delivery. Used for kitchen workflow planning and guest expectation management.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS Kitchen Display System

attributes.name: seasonal_availability
attributes.description: Description of when the seasonal item is available (e.g., Summer Menu, Holiday Special, Spring 2024). Null for non-seasonal items.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS Menu Configuration

attributes.name: spice_level
attributes.description: Indicates the heat or spiciness level of the menu item. Used for guest preference matching and expectation setting.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS Item Attributes

attributes.name: standard_price
attributes.description: The standard selling price of the menu item before any discounts, promotions, or service charges. This is the base price used for revenue calculation and Average Daily Rate (ADR) contribution analysis.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: The tax classification for this menu item determining applicable sales tax, VAT, or GST rates. Categories vary by jurisdiction (e.g., food, alcohol, non-alcoholic beverage, prepared food, grocery).
attributes.references: Local Tax Authority Regulations / PCI DSS

products.name: recipe
products.description: Standardized recipe master for all food and beverage items, capturing recipe name, yield quantity, unit of measure, preparation method, cooking instructions, plating notes, standard food cost per portion, beverage cost per pour, ingredient list with quantities, and ISO 22000 critical control points (CCPs) for food safety compliance. Enables food cost percentage calculation, variance analysis, and supports procurement planning. Owned by F&B domain as the authoritative source for recipe costing.
products.reference: ISO 22000 Recipe / USALI Food Cost Standard

attributes.name: recipe_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the recipe. Primary key.

attributes.name: fnb_outlet_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary F&B outlet where this recipe is prepared and served. Links to property_outlet master data.

attributes.name: allergen_information
attributes.description: Comprehensive list of allergens present in this recipe (e.g., 'Contains: milk, eggs, tree nuts, shellfish'). Critical for guest safety, menu labeling compliance, and service staff training.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act

attributes.name: ccp_details
attributes.description: Detailed description of ISO 22000 Critical Control Points in this recipe, including monitoring procedures, critical limits, corrective actions, and verification steps. Essential for food safety compliance and audit readiness.

attributes.name: chef_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, tips, or special instructions from the executive chef. May include substitution options, quality standards, or presentation variations.

attributes.name: cooking_instructions
attributes.description: Specific cooking instructions including equipment, temperatures, techniques, and quality checkpoints. Supports standardization and training of kitchen staff.

attributes.name: cooking_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard time in minutes required to cook or finish the recipe. Critical for kitchen capacity planning, guest wait time estimation, and service flow management.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all cost amounts in this recipe (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Supports multi-currency operations and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recipe record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: cuisine_type
attributes.description: Culinary style or regional cuisine classification (e.g., 'Italian', 'Asian Fusion', 'Contemporary American'). Supports menu diversity analysis and guest preference tracking.

attributes.name: dietary_attributes
attributes.description: Dietary classifications and attributes (e.g., 'vegetarian', 'vegan', 'gluten-free', 'dairy-free', 'halal', 'kosher'). Supports menu filtering, guest preference matching, and inclusive dining experiences.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this recipe version became active and available for use. Supports historical costing and menu change tracking.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this recipe version was superseded or discontinued. Null for currently active recipes. Supports historical analysis and audit trails.

attributes.name: haccp_hazard_analysis
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) Hazard Analysis
attributes.description: Documented hazard analysis identifying biological, chemical, and physical hazards associated with this recipe. Required for HACCP compliance and food safety management.

attributes.name: iso_22000_ccp_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this recipe contains one or more ISO 22000 Critical Control Points requiring food safety monitoring and documentation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recipe record was last updated. Supports change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: nutritional_calories
attributes.description: Total calories per standard portion. Required for menu labeling compliance in many jurisdictions and supports wellness-focused guest preferences.

attributes.name: nutritional_carbohydrate_grams
attributes.description: Total carbohydrate content in grams per standard portion. Supports dietary planning and menu labeling compliance.

attributes.name: nutritional_fat_grams
attributes.description: Total fat content in grams per standard portion. Required for nutritional labeling and dietary analysis.

attributes.name: nutritional_protein_grams
attributes.description: Protein content in grams per standard portion. Supports nutritional transparency and wellness program requirements.

attributes.name: nutritional_sodium_milligrams
attributes.description: Sodium content in milligrams per standard portion. Critical for health-conscious guests and dietary restriction management.

attributes.name: plating_instructions
attributes.description: Detailed instructions for plating and presentation, including garnish placement, portion arrangement, and visual standards. Ensures brand consistency and guest experience quality.

attributes.name: portion_size_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the standard portion size (e.g., 'ounce', 'gram', 'milliliter'). Ensures consistency in portioning and cost calculation.

attributes.name: preparation_method
attributes.description: Detailed step-by-step instructions for preparing the recipe, including ingredient handling, cooking techniques, temperatures, and timing. Ensures consistency and quality across all outlets.

attributes.name: preparation_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard time in minutes required to prepare ingredients before cooking (e.g., chopping, marinating, mixing). Used for kitchen labor planning and workflow optimization.

attributes.name: recipe_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code for the recipe, used across Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS and kitchen systems for item lookup and ordering.

attributes.name: recipe_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the recipe as it appears on menus and in kitchen systems (e.g., 'Grilled Atlantic Salmon', 'Signature Chocolate Lava Cake').

attributes.name: recipe_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the recipe. Active recipes are available for service; seasonal recipes are available during specific periods; testing recipes are in development; discontinued recipes are archived.

attributes.name: recipe_type
attributes.description: Classification of the recipe by menu category or preparation type. Supports menu engineering and F&B departmental reporting per USALI standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: appetizer|entree|dessert|beverage|side|sauce|garnish|base_prep — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: seasonal_availability
attributes.description: Seasonal availability window for this recipe (e.g., 'Summer Menu June-August', 'Holiday Special December', 'Year-Round'). Supports menu planning and ingredient procurement.

attributes.name: shelf_life_hours
attributes.description: Maximum time in hours that the prepared recipe can be safely held before service or disposal. Critical for food safety, waste management, and batch production planning.

attributes.name: skill_level_required
attributes.description: The culinary skill level required to execute this recipe consistently (basic, intermediate, advanced, expert). Used for staff assignment, training planning, and labor scheduling.

attributes.name: standard_beverage_cost_per_portion
attributes.description: The calculated cost of beverage ingredients (wine, spirits, mixers) required to produce one standard portion. Applicable to beverage recipes and cocktails. Supports beverage cost percentage tracking.

attributes.name: standard_food_cost_per_portion
attributes.description: The calculated cost of ingredients required to produce one standard portion of this recipe. Foundation for menu pricing, food cost percentage analysis, and GOP calculation per USALI standards.

attributes.name: standard_portion_size
attributes.description: The standard serving size per portion in the specified unit of measure. Critical for portion control, cost consistency, and nutritional labeling compliance.

attributes.name: storage_instructions
attributes.description: Proper storage requirements for prepared recipe or components, including temperature range, container type, and maximum hold time. Critical for food safety and quality maintenance.

attributes.name: total_recipe_cost
attributes.description: The total cost to produce the full recipe yield (all portions). Calculated as sum of all ingredient costs. Used for batch costing and procurement planning.

attributes.name: total_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes from start to finish, including preparation, cooking, and plating. Used for kitchen scheduling and service time commitments.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this recipe specification. Incremented when recipe is modified. Supports change tracking and historical cost analysis.

attributes.name: yield_quantity
attributes.description: The number of portions or servings this recipe produces when prepared according to standard method. Used for portion cost calculation and inventory planning.

attributes.name: yield_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the recipe yield quantity (e.g., 'portion', 'ounce', 'liter'). Standardizes recipe costing and inventory consumption tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: portion|serving|ounce|gram|liter|milliliter|piece|dozen — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: recipe_ingredient
products.description: Line-level ingredient composition for each standardized recipe, capturing ingredient name, ingredient category (protein, produce, dairy, dry goods, beverage), quantity required, unit of measure, standard cost per unit, substitution flag, and allergen contribution. Supports food cost roll-up per recipe, procurement demand planning, and ISO 22000 ingredient traceability requirements. Each row represents one ingredient within one recipe.

attributes.name: recipe_ingredient_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each ingredient line within a recipe. Primary key for the recipe ingredient entity.

attributes.name: primary_recipe_fnb_inventory_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ingredient master record. Links to the ingredient catalog for standardized ingredient definitions.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS - Inventory Management

attributes.name: recipe_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent standardized recipe that this ingredient belongs to. Links to the recipe master data.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS - Recipe Management

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is currently active in the recipe. False if ingredient has been removed or temporarily suspended. Supports recipe version control.

attributes.name: allergen_contribution
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of allergens present in this ingredient (e.g., dairy, gluten, nuts, shellfish, soy, eggs). Critical for guest safety, menu labeling, and regulatory compliance with food allergen disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 22000 - Allergen Management; FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this recipe ingredient record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: critical_control_point_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient represents a Critical Control Point in the HACCP (Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points) food safety plan. True if special handling, temperature control, or monitoring is required.
attributes.references: ISO 22000 - HACCP Principles; Local Health Department Food Safety Codes

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this ingredient was removed from the recipe or replaced. Null if ingredient is currently active. Supports recipe version history.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this ingredient became part of the recipe. Supports recipe change tracking and historical cost analysis.

attributes.name: extended_cost
attributes.description: Total cost for this ingredient line, calculated as quantity_required multiplied by standard_cost_per_unit. Supports recipe-level food cost aggregation.

attributes.name: ingredient_category
attributes.description: Classification of the ingredient by food category. Used for food cost analysis, procurement planning, and inventory management by category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: protein|produce|dairy|dry_goods|beverage|spice|condiment|oil_fat|seafood|bakery — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ingredient_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the ingredient as it appears in the recipe. May differ from master ingredient name for recipe-specific context.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering of ingredients within the recipe. Used for display and preparation sequence.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) - F&B Departmental Standards

attributes.name: local_sourcing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is sourced locally (typically within 100 miles of the property). Supports sustainability initiatives and farm-to-table marketing programs.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity that must be ordered from the supplier for this ingredient. Used for procurement planning and inventory optimization.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this recipe ingredient record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this recipe ingredient record was last modified. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: nutritional_value_per_unit
attributes.description: Nutritional information for one unit of this ingredient (calories, protein, fat, carbohydrates, sodium). Stored as structured text or JSON. Supports menu nutrition labeling and dietary analysis.
attributes.references: FDA Nutrition Labeling Requirements; Menu Labeling Regulations

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is certified organic by a recognized certification body. Supports menu labeling and premium positioning.

attributes.name: par_level
attributes.description: The standard inventory level that should be maintained for this ingredient to support recipe production without stockouts. Used for automated reorder point calculation.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS - Inventory Management

attributes.name: preparation_instruction
attributes.description: Specific preparation notes for this ingredient within the recipe context (e.g., diced, julienned, blanched, room temperature). Supports kitchen execution and quality consistency.

attributes.name: quantity_required
attributes.description: The amount of this ingredient required for one batch or serving of the recipe. Precision supports fractional measurements common in culinary applications.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS - Recipe Costing

attributes.name: seasonality_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient has seasonal availability constraints. True if ingredient availability or cost varies significantly by season.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days this ingredient remains usable under proper storage conditions. Supports inventory rotation (FIFO) and waste reduction.

attributes.name: standard_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: The standard cost of one unit of this ingredient at the time of recipe creation or last update. Used for recipe cost roll-up and food cost percentage calculation. Business-confidential pricing data.

attributes.name: storage_requirement
attributes.description: Required storage condition for this ingredient to maintain quality and safety. Critical for inventory management and food safety compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 22000 - Storage and Handling Standards; Local Health Department Codes

attributes.name: substitution_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient can be substituted with an alternative ingredient without compromising recipe quality or guest expectations. True if substitution is permitted, False if ingredient is critical.

attributes.name: traceability_code
attributes.description: Unique code or lot number for ingredient traceability from supplier to finished dish. Required for ISO 22000 compliance and food safety incident response.
attributes.references: ISO 22000 - Traceability Requirements; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA)

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the ingredient quantity is measured. Standardized to support recipe costing and procurement conversion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kg|g|lb|oz|l|ml|gal|qt|pt|cup|tbsp|tsp|each|dozen|case — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: waste_percentage
attributes.description: The expected waste percentage for this ingredient during preparation (e.g., trim loss, bones, shells). Inverse of yield percentage, used for sustainability tracking and cost accuracy.

attributes.name: yield_percentage
attributes.description: The usable percentage of the ingredient after preparation and waste removal (e.g., 75% for vegetables after trimming). Used for accurate cost calculation and procurement planning.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this recipe ingredient record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

products.name: pos_check
products.description: Core POS transaction record representing a guest check opened at any F&B outlet or service channel including dine-in, bar, room service, takeaway, delivery, and poolside. Captures check number, outlet, table, server, cover count, open/close timestamps, status (open, closed, voided, transferred), meal period, order type (dine-in, bar, room service, takeaway, delivery, poolside), subtotal, discounts, service charge, tax, total, payment method, tender amount, tip, and PMS folio posting reference. For room service orders: guest room number, requested delivery time, actual delivery time, delivery duration (minutes), order source (phone, in-room tablet, mobile app), and delivery status (received, in-preparation, dispatched, delivered, cancelled). Supports room service operational KPIs including on-time delivery rate and average delivery time. Primary transactional entity sourced from Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS. Single source of truth for all F&B guest orders regardless of service channel.

attributes.references: USALI F&B Cost of Sales Accounting

attributes.name: course_number
attributes.description: Course sequence indicator for multi-course dining. Determines kitchen firing order and service timing. Common values: 1=appetizer, 2=entree, 3=dessert.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS - Course Sequencing

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this line item record was first created in the POS system. Represents the moment the item was ordered by the guest or server.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS - Transaction Audit Trail

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this line. Supports multi-currency operations and foreign exchange tracking.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to this line item. Includes promotional discounts, employee discounts, manager comps, and loyalty redemptions.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS - Discount Detail

attributes.name: family_group_code
attributes.description: Mid-level menu category classification within major group. Examples: appetizers, entrees, desserts, wine, beer, spirits. Enables detailed menu mix reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS - Menu Hierarchy

attributes.name: is_complimentary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item was provided as a complimentary item (no charge to guest). True for comps, false for paid items. Used for cost tracking and guest recovery analysis.

attributes.name: is_inclusive_tax
attributes.description: Indicates whether tax is included in the unit price (true) or added separately (false). Varies by jurisdiction and pricing strategy.
attributes.references: Local Tax Authority Requirements; VAT/GST Regulations

attributes.name: is_open_item
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line was entered as an open-priced item where the server manually entered the price rather than selecting from menu. Used for special items and manager overrides.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS - Open Item Control

attributes.name: is_voided
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item was voided after being ordered. True if voided, false if active. Voided lines are excluded from revenue but tracked for audit and waste analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS - Void Control

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this line item record was last updated. Tracks modifications such as quantity changes, price adjustments, or void actions.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS - Transaction Audit Trail

attributes.name: line_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering of this line item within the parent check. Determines display and printing order.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS - Line Sequence

attributes.name: line_subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Extended amount for this line calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price, before discounts and taxes. Base revenue for the line item.

attributes.name: line_total_amount
attributes.description: Final total amount for this line item including all charges, discounts, taxes, and service charges. Net revenue contribution from this line.

attributes.name: major_group_code
attributes.description: High-level menu category classification for this item. Examples: food, beverage, alcohol, non-alcohol. Used for USALI departmental reporting and revenue mix analysis.

attributes.name: modifier_text
attributes.description: Free-form text capturing cooking instructions, preparation preferences, add-ons, substitutions, and removals for this menu item. Examples: no onions, extra cheese, well done, gluten-free bun.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS - Condiment/Modifier Detail

attributes.name: preparation_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard kitchen preparation time for this menu item in minutes. Used for kitchen capacity planning and guest wait time estimation.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS - Kitchen Display System

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: Number of units of this menu item ordered on this line. Supports fractional quantities for items sold by weight or partial portions.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS - Item Quantity

attributes.name: seat_number
attributes.description: Seat position at the table for this line item. Enables per-guest ordering and split-check processing. Used in full-service restaurant operations.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS - Seat Assignment

attributes.name: sent_to_kitchen_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this line item order was transmitted to the kitchen display system or printed to kitchen printer. Marks start of preparation cycle.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS - Kitchen Display System

attributes.name: served_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this item was marked as served to the guest. Used for service time analysis and kitchen performance measurement.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS - Service Tracking

attributes.name: service_charge_amount
attributes.description: Mandatory service charge or gratuity applied to this line item. Common for banquet events, room service, and large party dining.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax charged on this line item. Includes sales tax, VAT, GST, or other applicable consumption taxes based on jurisdiction and item taxability.
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Tax Calculation; Local Tax Authority Requirements

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Selling price per unit of the menu item at the time of order. Reflects the base price before modifiers, discounts, or service charges.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS - Item Price

attributes.name: void_reason_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the reason this line item was voided. Examples: guest changed mind, kitchen error, wrong item entered, quality issue. Required when is_voided is true.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS - Void Reason

attributes.name: void_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this line item was voided. Null if not voided. Used for void pattern analysis and operational controls.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS - Void Audit Trail

products.name: revenue_center
products.description: Reference master for F&B revenue centers as defined under USALI departmental accounting standards. Maps each outlet and service type to its USALI revenue center code, department code, GL account mapping, cost center, revenue category (food revenue, beverage revenue, other F&B revenue, banquet food revenue, banquet beverage revenue, minibar revenue), and reporting hierarchy. Enables USALI-compliant P&L reporting at the outlet and property level. Serves as the authoritative bridge between operational POS transaction data and financial reporting in SAP S/4HANA. Required for month-end close, food cost percentage reporting, beverage cost percentage reporting, and banquet F&B revenue allocation.

attributes.name: food_cost_target_percentage

attributes.name: gl_account_code

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: operating_hours_description

attributes.name: outlet_type

attributes.name: reporting_hierarchy_level

products.name: stock_transaction
products.description: Single source of truth for all F&B inventory movements and waste events across outlets and storerooms. Captures transaction type (receipt, issue-to-outlet, inter-outlet transfer, spoilage, over-production waste, plate waste, breakage, expired stock, physical count adjustment, end-of-day consumption, return-to-vendor), item reference, quantity, unit cost, total cost, source location, destination location, transaction timestamp, and authorizing manager. For waste/spoilage transactions: waste category, waste reason, meal period, recording staff, and corrective action notes. Supports food cost variance analysis, par level management, sustainability reporting, waste reduction KPIs, and ISO 22000 stock traceability. Integrates waste tracking previously in separate waste logs to provide unified inventory and waste analytics.

products.name: banquet_package_composition
products.description: This association product represents the Package Composition between banquet_menu_package and menu_item. It captures the structured bill-of-materials for each banquet menu package, defining exactly which menu items are included, in what course position, in what sequence, and in what per-person quantity. Each record links one banquet_menu_package to one menu_item with attributes that exist only in the context of this package-item relationship — course assignment, service sequence, per-person quantity, optionality, and substitution rules. Supports BEO generation, catering cost control, and package quoting in Delphi by Amadeus.. Existence Justification: In hotel banquet operations, a banquet menu package is literally defined by its composition of individual menu items — a 'Wedding Gala Package' contains specific appetizers, entrées, desserts, and beverages drawn from the menu item catalog. One package contains many menu items, and one menu item (e.g., 'Grilled Salmon Entrée') can appear in many packages. The business actively manages this composition through BEO (Banquet Event Order) systems like Delphi by Amadeus, where catering managers build and modify package compositions with course assignments, sequence ordering, and per-person quantities.

attributes.business_glossary_term: Banquet Package Composition - Banquet Package Composition Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the banquet_package_composition association

attributes.name: banquet_menu_package_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Banquet Package Composition - Banquet Menu Package Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the banquet menu package that this composition line belongs to

attributes.name: menu_item_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Banquet Package Composition - Menu Item Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the specific menu item included in this package composition

attributes.name: course_number
attributes.description: The meal course to which this menu item is assigned within the package (e.g., 1=Appetizer, 2=Soup, 3=Salad, 4=Main, 5=Dessert). Drives BEO course sequencing and kitchen production scheduling. Cannot reside on banquet_menu_package (varies per item) or menu_item (varies per package).

attributes.name: included_courses
attributes.description: Detailed description of all food courses included in the package (e.g., 'Appetizer, Salad, Entrée with Two Sides, Dessert, Bread Service'). Used in BEO (Banquet Event Order) documentation. [Moved from banquet_menu_package: This STRING field on banquet_menu_package is a denormalized free-text description of course inclusions (e.g., 'Appetizer, Entrée, Dessert, Coffee'). With the banquet_package_composition association table now providing structured, item-level course assignments via course_number and sequence_number, this field becomes redundant and should be deprecated or replaced by a derived/computed description. It cannot accurately represent the structured M:N composition and is a data quality risk.]
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: is_optional
attributes.description: Indicates whether this menu item is a mandatory component of the package or an optional add-on that guests may decline. Mandatory items are always included in the per-person price; optional items may affect pricing. Belongs to the composition relationship.

attributes.name: quantity_per_person
attributes.description: The number of units of this menu item served per guest within the package (e.g., 2 bread rolls, 1 entrée, 0.5 for shared platters). Critical for food cost calculation and production planning. Belongs to the composition relationship, not to either parent.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Display and service order of this menu item within its assigned course. Used to control the order items appear on BEOs and are called from the kitchen. Cannot reside on either parent entity as it is specific to the package-item pairing.

attributes.name: substitution_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether guests or event planners may substitute this menu item for an alternative within the package. Drives catering flexibility rules and BEO amendment workflows. Belongs to the composition relationship, not to either parent entity.

attributes.description: Final disposition action taken for the item after the retention period or claim resolution.
attributes.references: Property Lost and Found Policy, Local Unclaimed Property Regulations

attributes.name: estimated_value_amount
attributes.description: Estimated monetary value of the item in the property's base currency for liability and insurance purposes.

attributes.name: guest_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when the guest was successfully notified about the found item.

attributes.name: guest_notification_method
attributes.description: Communication channel used to notify the guest about the found item.

attributes.name: guest_notification_status
attributes.description: Status of attempts to notify the guest about the discovered item.

attributes.name: is_high_value_item
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the item exceeds the property's high-value threshold requiring special handling and management approval.

attributes.name: item_brand
attributes.description: Brand or manufacturer name of the item, if identifiable.

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the lost item type for inventory and reporting purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: electronics|jewelry|clothing|documents|keys|wallet|luggage|personal_care|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AHLA Lost and Found Best Practices

attributes.name: item_color
attributes.description: Primary color of the item for identification purposes.

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the lost item including brand, color, size, distinguishing features, and condition at time of discovery.

attributes.name: item_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique tracking number assigned to the lost and found item for guest reference and claim processing.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lost and found record was last updated.

attributes.name: lost_and_found_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the lost and found item tracking its progression from discovery through final disposition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: logged|guest_notified|claimed|pending_disposition|returned_to_guest|donated|discarded|turned_over_to_authorities — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: General notes and comments regarding the item, discovery circumstances, guest interactions, or special considerations.

attributes.name: photo_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to photograph of the item for identification and verification purposes.

attributes.name: requires_special_handling
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the item requires special storage conditions or handling procedures (e.g., refrigeration, secure vault).

attributes.name: retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the retention period expires and the item becomes eligible for disposition.
attributes.references: Local Unclaimed Property Regulations, Property Lost and Found Policy

attributes.name: retention_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days the item must be retained before disposition per property policy and local regulations.
attributes.references: Local Unclaimed Property Regulations, Property Lost and Found Policy

attributes.name: shipping_cost_amount
attributes.description: Cost charged to the guest for shipping the item to their location.

attributes.name: shipping_tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier tracking number if the item was shipped to the guest at their request.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Specific instructions for handling, storing, or preserving the item.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Secure storage location identifier where the item is being held (e.g., safe number, locker ID, storage room shelf).

products.name: cleaning_standard
products.description: Reference master defining standard operating procedures, quality benchmarks, and amenity placement configurations for each cleaning type (stayover, departure, deep clean, turndown, public area) and room type/guest segment combination. Includes required tasks checklist, minimum time allocation, amenity items and placement instructions, linen change protocol, chemical product specifications, brand tier requirements, loyalty tier upgrade amenities, and brand compliance standards. Used to configure cleaning task templates, drive quality inspection scoring, and generate attendant placement checklists.

attributes.name: cleaning_standard_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cleaning standard configuration. Primary key.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - Housekeeping Data Standards

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Brand compliance reporting requires cleaning standards to be formally linked to a brand. Brand managers define and audit cleaning protocols per brand (e.g., Waldorf vs. Hampton). brand_tier is a denor

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.market_segment. Business justification: Brand standards and PIP compliance require segment-differentiated cleaning protocols: luxury transient guests receive different amenity placement, linen change frequency, and inspection thresholds tha

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier. Business justification: Tier-based room preparation: housekeeping applies distinct cleaning standards (amenity placement, linen protocols, welcome gifts) per loyalty tier. Operations and brand compliance teams report on tier

attributes.name: amenity_items_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated or structured list of amenity items to be placed (e.g., shampoo, conditioner, body lotion, soap, dental kit, sewing kit, coffee pods, bottled water). Varies by brand tier and guest segment.

attributes.name: amenity_placement_instructions
attributes.description: Detailed instructions for amenity item placement and presentation (e.g., toiletries arrangement, towel folding style, welcome card positioning, turndown chocolate placement). Ensures brand consistency and guest experience quality.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date this cleaning standard was approved for operational use. Required for compliance audit trail.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved this cleaning standard (e.g., Director of Housekeeping, Brand Standards Manager). Required for brand compliance and audit trail.

attributes.name: brand_compliance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this standard is mandatory for brand compliance audits. True if required for franchise/brand certification. Non-compliance may result in brand penalties.

attributes.name: certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether attendants must complete certification training before executing this standard. True for specialized standards (e.g., deep clean, hazardous material handling, luxury suite service).
attributes.references: OSHA Training Requirements, HTNG Housekeeping Certification

attributes.name: chemical_product_specifications
attributes.description: Approved cleaning chemical products and usage instructions (e.g., all-purpose cleaner brand/dilution, glass cleaner, bathroom sanitizer, disinfectant contact time). Ensures safety compliance and brand standards.
attributes.references: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) Hazard Communication Standard, ISO 22000 Food Safety

attributes.name: cleaning_standard_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cleaning standard: active (in use), inactive (temporarily disabled), draft (under development), archived (historical record).

attributes.name: cleaning_type
attributes.description: Type of cleaning service this standard defines: stayover (occupied room daily service), departure (checkout deep clean), deep_clean (periodic intensive cleaning), turndown (evening service), public_area (lobby/corridor/amenity spaces), refresh (quick tidy between same-day checkouts).
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) - Housekeeping Department Standards

attributes.name: cost_per_execution_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated total cost in USD to execute this cleaning standard once, including labor, supplies, and equipment depreciation. Used for CPOR (Cost Per Occupied Room) budgeting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cleaning standard record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date this cleaning standard becomes active and enforceable. Used for seasonal standard changes and brand compliance rollouts.

attributes.name: equipment_required
attributes.description: List of equipment and tools required to execute this standard (e.g., vacuum cleaner, microfiber cloths, mop, caddy, UV sanitizer). Used for attendant assignment and equipment allocation.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date this cleaning standard is no longer valid. Null for indefinite standards. Used for seasonal or promotional service upgrades.

attributes.name: inspection_pass_threshold_score
attributes.description: Minimum quality inspection score (0-100 scale) required to pass this cleaning standard. Rooms scoring below threshold require re-cleaning. Typical luxury threshold: 95+, select service: 85+.

attributes.name: labor_cost_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated labor cost in USD for this cleaning standard execution, calculated as target_time_minutes multiplied by average hourly wage. Primary component of CPOR.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date this cleaning standard was last reviewed for accuracy and relevance. Standards should be reviewed annually or when brand requirements change.

attributes.name: linen_change_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between scheduled linen changes when protocol is every_n_days. Null for other protocols. Typical values: 2-3 for luxury, 3-5 for select service.

attributes.name: linen_change_protocol
attributes.description: Linen replacement policy for this standard: full_change (all linens replaced), on_request (guest opt-in), every_n_days (scheduled rotation), departure_only (checkout only). Impacts sustainability metrics and laundry costs.

attributes.name: maximum_time_minutes
attributes.description: Maximum allowable time in minutes for this cleaning standard. Exceeding this threshold triggers supervisor review and quality audit.

attributes.name: minimum_time_minutes
attributes.description: Minimum time allocation in minutes required to complete this cleaning standard. Used for labor scheduling, productivity tracking, and CPOR (Cost Per Occupied Room) calculation.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cleaning standard record was last modified. Audit trail field for change tracking.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next review of this cleaning standard. Used for governance and continuous improvement workflows.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes for additional context, historical changes, or operational guidance not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_criteria
attributes.description: Structured quality inspection checklist and scoring rubric (e.g., cleanliness score, amenity placement accuracy, linen presentation, bathroom sanitation). Used by supervisors and quality auditors to validate standard compliance.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Additional notes or special handling requirements (e.g., allergy-friendly cleaning for sensitive guests, pet-friendly room protocols, post-construction deep clean procedures).

attributes.name: standard_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the cleaning standard (e.g., STY_LUX_SUITE, DEP_STD_KING, DEEP_PREM_DBL). Used for operational reference and system integration.

attributes.name: standard_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the cleaning standard (e.g., Luxury Suite Stayover Service, Premium Departure Clean).

attributes.name: supply_consumption_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated quantity of consumable supplies per cleaning execution (e.g., 2 trash bags, 1 toilet paper roll, 50ml all-purpose cleaner). Used for inventory forecasting and CPOR calculation.

attributes.name: supply_cost_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated consumable supply cost in USD per execution (chemicals, amenities, linens, trash bags). Used for inventory budgeting and CPOR calculation.

attributes.name: sustainability_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this standard meets corporate sustainability and environmental compliance requirements (e.g., eco-friendly chemicals, linen reuse program, water conservation). True if compliant.
attributes.references: AHLA Sustainability Guidelines, ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: target_time_minutes
attributes.description: Target time in minutes for completing this cleaning standard under normal conditions. Used for performance benchmarking and efficiency KPIs.

attributes.name: task_checklist
attributes.description: Structured list of required cleaning tasks in sequence (e.g., strip linens, dust surfaces, vacuum, sanitize bathroom, restock amenities). Stored as delimited text or JSON. Used to generate attendant mobile app checklists.

attributes.name: training_module_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the training module or learning content that teaches this cleaning standard (e.g., LMS course ID, training video URL, SOP document number). Used for onboarding and certification.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this cleaning standard configuration. Incremented when standard is updated. Supports audit trail and change management.

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Financial management including GL, AP, AR, budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting per USALI standards and GAAP/IFRS. Manages property-level P&L, departmental accounting, capital expenditure tracking (CapEx, FF&E), and consolidated financial statements. Tracks GOP, EBITDA, NOI calculations. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA. Supports SOX financial controls for publicly traded entities.
domains.references: USALI / GAAP / IFRS Financial Reporting Standards

products.name: ledger
products.description: General Ledger (GL) master entity representing the chart of accounts structure per USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) standards. Each ledger account defines an account number, account name, account type (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense), account group, normal balance indicator, and currency. Serves as the authoritative financial record backbone for all property-level and consolidated financial reporting including income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, GOP, EBITDA, NOI, and GOPPAR calculations. Supports period-end financial statement generation and multi-property consolidation with intercompany elimination. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA GL module.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA General Ledger / USALI Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the general ledger account. Primary key.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Some GL accounts have default cost centers for automatic allocation when no specific cost center is provided on transactions. The cost_center_code STRING should be replaced with a proper FK to cost_ce

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Some GL accounts have default profit centers for automatic allocation when no specific profit center is provided on transactions. The profit_center_code STRING should be replaced with a proper FK to p

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the property to which this ledger account belongs. Supports property-level chart of accounts and multi-property financial consolidation. Links to the property master entity.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: account_category
attributes.description: The USALI-defined category grouping for the account (e.g., Rooms, Food and Beverage, Other Operated Departments, Administrative and General, Sales and Marketing, Property Operations and Maintenance, Utilities, Fixed Charges). Used for departmental P&L reporting and GOP calculation.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The descriptive name of the general ledger account (e.g., Room Revenue, Food and Beverage Cost of Sales, Payroll and Related Expenses, Property Operations and Maintenance).
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The unique account number assigned to this general ledger account per USALI chart of accounts structure. Typically 4-10 digit numeric code used for financial reporting and transaction posting.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: account_subcategory
attributes.description: The detailed subcategory within the USALI account category (e.g., within Food and Beverage: Restaurant Revenue, Banquet Revenue, Room Service Revenue; within Rooms: Payroll and Related, Guest Supplies, Laundry and Linen). Enables granular financial analysis.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The fundamental accounting classification of the ledger account: asset, liability, equity, revenue, or expense. Determines placement in financial statements and normal balance behavior.
attributes.references: GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles), IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards)

attributes.name: audit_trail_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether detailed audit trail documentation is required for all transactions posted to this account. Used for high-risk accounts, regulatory compliance, and forensic accounting.

attributes.name: balance_sheet_section
attributes.description: The section of the balance sheet where this account appears (current assets, non-current assets, current liabilities, non-current liabilities, equity). Determines liquidity classification and working capital calculation.
attributes.references: GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles), IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards)

attributes.name: cash_flow_classification
attributes.description: The cash flow statement category for this account: operating activities, investing activities, or financing activities. Used for automated cash flow statement preparation per GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles), IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards)

attributes.name: consolidation_account
attributes.description: The account number used for consolidation at the corporate or regional level. Maps property-level accounts to standardized corporate chart of accounts for multi-property financial consolidation.
attributes.references: GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles), IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ledger account record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which this ledger account is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency accounting for global property portfolios.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this ledger account becomes inactive and no longer accepts new transactions. Null for accounts with no planned end date. Used for account retirement and chart of accounts cleanup.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA General Ledger Master Data

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this ledger account becomes active and available for transaction posting. Supports phased chart of accounts implementation and account structure changes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA General Ledger Master Data

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: The functional area classification for financial statement presentation (e.g., Operating Revenue, Cost of Sales, Operating Expenses, Fixed Charges). Used for USALI-compliant income statement formatting and GOP calculation.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: income_statement_section
attributes.description: The section of the income statement where this account appears per USALI format (e.g., Operated Departments Revenue, Operated Departments Expenses, Undistributed Operating Expenses, Fixed Charges). Supports GOP, EBITDA, and NOI calculation.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ledger account is currently active and available for transaction posting. Inactive accounts are retained for historical reporting but cannot accept new transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA General Ledger Master Data

attributes.name: is_control_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a control account (summary account) that aggregates balances from subsidiary ledgers (e.g., Accounts Receivable control account summarizing individual guest folios). Control accounts do not accept direct postings.
attributes.references: GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles), SAP S/4HANA General Ledger

attributes.name: is_intercompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is used for intercompany transactions between properties or legal entities within the hospitality group. Intercompany accounts are eliminated during consolidated financial statement preparation.
attributes.references: GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles), IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards)

attributes.name: is_reconciliation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account requires periodic reconciliation (e.g., bank accounts, accounts receivable, inventory accounts). Used for internal control and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: is_statistical
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a statistical account used for non-monetary metrics (e.g., room nights sold, covers served, occupied room count). Statistical accounts support KPI calculation (ADR, RevPAR, GOPPAR) but do not carry monetary balances.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: last_posting_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent transaction posted to this account. Used for dormant account identification and account usage analysis.

attributes.name: ledger_description
attributes.description: Extended description of the ledger account purpose, usage guidelines, and posting rules. Provides additional context beyond the account name for accounting staff and auditors.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ledger account record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: normal_balance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account normally carries a debit or credit balance. Assets and expenses have debit normal balances; liabilities, equity, and revenue have credit normal balances. Used for transaction validation and financial statement preparation.
attributes.references: GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles), IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes field for special instructions, reconciliation notes, or account-specific documentation. Used by accounting staff for operational guidance and audit documentation.

attributes.name: posting_block_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether direct posting to this account is blocked. Posting blocks are used for control accounts, summary accounts, or accounts under investigation. Transactions must be posted to subsidiary accounts instead.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA General Ledger Master Data

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is subject to SOX internal control testing and documentation requirements. Typically true for material accounts affecting financial statement accuracy for publicly traded hospitality companies.

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: The tax category or tax line item code associated with this account for tax reporting purposes (e.g., taxable revenue, non-taxable revenue, deductible expense, non-deductible expense). Supports automated tax return preparation.
attributes.references: IRS (Internal Revenue Service), Local Tax Authorities

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Organizational cost center master representing departmental accounting units within each property (e.g., Rooms, F&B, Spa, Administration). Aligns with USALI departmental P&L structure. Used for allocating OpEx, labor costs, and overhead across operating departments. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) module.
products.reference: SAP CO Cost Center / USALI Departmental Accounting

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost center. Primary key.

attributes.name: parent_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to a parent cost center in a hierarchical cost center structure, enabling roll-up reporting and consolidated P&L views. Null if this is a top-level cost center.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property to which this cost center belongs.

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: The total annual budgeted amount allocated to this cost center for the current fiscal year, used for variance analysis and financial control.

attributes.name: audit_trail_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all financial transactions posted to this cost center must maintain a full audit trail for compliance and internal control purposes (True) or standard logging is sufficient (False).

attributes.name: budget_allocation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center has a dedicated budget allocation and is subject to budget control and variance reporting (True) or operates without a formal budget (False).

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code representing the legal entity to which this cost center belongs, used for consolidated financial reporting and legal compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) Company Code

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: The SAP controlling area under which this cost center is managed, representing the organizational unit for internal cost accounting and management reporting.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: The method used to allocate shared costs or overhead to this cost center: direct assignment, activity-based costing, percentage allocation, headcount-based, or square footage-based.
attributes.references: USALI Cost Allocation Guidelines, SAP S/4HANA CO Assessment/Distribution

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying the cost center within the property and financial system. Used in GL postings and financial reports.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Master, USALI Departmental Structure

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the cost center's purpose, scope, and operational responsibilities.

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: The full business name of the cost center (e.g., Rooms Division, Food and Beverage, Spa Operations, Administration).

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center: active (operational and accepting postings), inactive (temporarily not in use), suspended (blocked for new postings), or closed (permanently retired).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Master Data Status

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost center by its primary function: revenue-generating departments, support services, administrative functions, or overhead allocation centers.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The username or employee identifier of the user who created this cost center record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost center record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which this cost center's financial transactions are recorded (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: department_category
attributes.description: High-level USALI category: Operated Departments (revenue-generating), Undistributed Operating Expenses (support), or Fixed Charges (property-level overhead).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this cost center ceased operations or was closed. Null for currently active cost centers.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this cost center became active and began accepting financial postings.

attributes.name: external_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center's financial results are included in external financial statements and regulatory filings (True) or used only for internal management reporting (False).

attributes.name: headcount_allocation
attributes.description: The number of full-time equivalent (FTE) employees allocated to this cost center, used for labor cost analysis and productivity metrics.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The depth of this cost center in the organizational hierarchy (1=top-level, 2=sub-department, etc.), used for roll-up aggregation and reporting.

attributes.name: labor_cost_tracking_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether labor costs (payroll, benefits, overtime) are tracked and allocated to this cost center (True) or excluded from labor cost analysis (False).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Activity-Based Costing, USALI Labor Cost Reporting

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or employee identifier of the user who last modified this cost center record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost center record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information about the cost center's operations, budget constraints, or reporting requirements.

attributes.name: revenue_posting_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether revenue transactions can be posted to this cost center (True for revenue-generating departments) or only expense postings are allowed (False for support/administrative centers).

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is subject to SOX financial controls and audit requirements (True for publicly traded entities) or exempt (False).

attributes.name: square_footage
attributes.description: The total square footage of physical space occupied by this cost center, used for space-based cost allocation and facility management analysis.

attributes.name: usali_department_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry (USALI) Department Code
attributes.description: The standard USALI departmental code aligning this cost center to the industry-standard chart of accounts for lodging P&L reporting (e.g., 10=Rooms, 20=Food, 30=Beverage, 40=Other Operated Departments, 50=Administrative & General).

products.name: profit_center
products.description: Profit center master representing revenue-generating business units within the property portfolio (e.g., individual hotels, resorts, F&B outlets, event venues). Enables property-level P&L reporting, RevPAR contribution analysis, and GOPPAR tracking. Supports consolidated financial statements across the portfolio. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Profit Center Accounting.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Profit Center Accounting / USALI

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the profit center. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the primary cost center associated with this profit center for expense allocation and departmental accounting per USALI standards.

attributes.name: ownership_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the legal ownership entity responsible for this profit center. Supports consolidated financial statements across the portfolio and inter-company eliminations.

attributes.name: parent_profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent profit center in a hierarchical profit center structure. Enables roll-up reporting for complex properties with nested profit centers (e.g., a resort with multiple F&B (Food and Beverage) outlets).

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent property or resort to which this profit center belongs. Enables property-level P&L (Profit and Loss) consolidation and RevPAR (Revenue Per Available Room) contribution analysis.

attributes.name: revenue_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the primary revenue center for this profit center. Used for revenue recognition and departmental revenue reporting per USALI.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the profit center's physical location. Required for property-level profit centers and standalone F&B (Food and Beverage) or event venues.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, floor, or building information.

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: Brand or franchise affiliation code for the profit center (e.g., Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, independent). Used for brand-level performance reporting and franchise fee calculations.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: SAP Business Area code for cross-company-code segment reporting. Enables consolidated reporting across multiple legal entities within the same business segment (e.g., luxury hotels, select-service properties).

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the profit center is located.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: The date the profit center was permanently closed. Used for historical analysis and asset disposition reporting.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP Company Code representing the legal entity for external financial reporting. Links profit center results to the general ledger and statutory financial statements.

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: SAP Controlling Area code to which this profit center is assigned. Defines the organizational boundary for internal cost and revenue accounting.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the profit center's location. Used for multi-country consolidation and compliance with local regulatory reporting requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this profit center record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking per SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) compliance requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code

products.name: budget
products.description: Annual and periodic financial budget master representing planned and forecasted financial targets at both header and line-item granularity. Each budget contains line items by GL account, cost center, profit center, and fiscal period combination. Supports approved annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and reforecasts (distinguished by budget type/version). Captures budgeted revenue (rooms, F&B, events), budgeted expenses (labor, CPOR, FF&E reserve contributions), and budgeted KPIs (ADR, OCC, RevPAR, GOP, EBITDA, NOI). Enables granular budget-vs-actual and forecast-vs-actual variance analysis at the account, department, and property level. Supports USALI departmental budget reporting and management review. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Planning and Budgeting module.

domains.name: marketing

Manages marketing campaigns, promotional offers, content management, social media engagement, and marketing attribution. Tracks campaign ROI, guest acquisition cost, NPS (Net Promoter Score), and GSS (Guest Satisfaction Score). Integrates with Salesforce CRM for personalized guest communications and retention programs.

Birthday offer provides member birthday recognition benefit. Package deal bundles multiple benefits. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: percentage_discount|flat_discount|free_night|room_upgrade|fnb_credit|bonus_points|tier_accelerator|partner_earn|member_rate|birthday_offer|package_deal — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: redemption_limit_total

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: End date after which this offer is no longer active. Reservations with arrival dates on or before this date are eligible. Null indicates open-ended validity.

attributes.name: execution_status

attributes.name: execution_timestamp

attributes.name: payment_status

attributes.name: scheduled_timestamp

attributes.name: send_count

attributes.name: spend_category

attributes.name: subject_line

attributes.name: tracking_capability

products.name: guest_segment

SSOT for both segment definitions and guest-to-segment membership associations. Enables point-in-time segment membership queries and supports campaign audience list generation. Distinct from loyalty tier — this is the marketing segmentation layer used for campaign targeting and personalization strategy.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this segment definition became active and available for campaign targeting and personalization.

attributes.name: last_refresh_date

attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this segment for personalized guest communications and offers: high (premium personalization), medium (standard personalization), low (generic communications).

attributes.name: refresh_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which segment membership is recalculated and refreshed to reflect current guest behavior and attributes.

attributes.name: segment_code

attributes.name: segment_creation_method

attributes.name: segment_description

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the guest segment (e.g., Luxury Frequent Travelers, Business Travelers, Leisure Families).

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the segment definition: active (in use for campaigns), inactive (paused), draft (under development), archived (retired).

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the segmentation methodology used: behavioral (booking patterns, stay frequency), demographic (age, income), geographic (region, country), RFM (Recency Frequency Monetary), loyalty tier-based (elite status), or occasion-based (business, leisure, events).

attributes.name: target_gss_min

attributes.name: target_ltv_min

attributes.name: target_nps_min
attributes.description: Minimum Net Promoter Score threshold used in segment definition criteria for satisfaction-based segmentation. Null if NPS is not a defining criterion.

attributes.name: target_stay_frequency_min
attributes.description: Minimum number of stays per year used in segment definition criteria for frequency-based segmentation. Null if stay frequency is not a defining criterion.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the marketing user or system that created this segment definition.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: crm_activity_code

attributes.name: delivered_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the communication was successfully delivered to the recipient's mail server or device. Null if delivery failed or is pending.

attributes.name: delivery_status

attributes.name: language_code

attributes.name: locale_code

attributes.name: opened_timestamp

attributes.name: opt_in_status

attributes.name: personalization_fields
attributes.description: JSON or delimited string containing the dynamic merge fields and their values used to personalize this communication. Examples: guest name, loyalty tier, reservation dates, property name.

attributes.name: sender_name

attributes.name: sent_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the communication was sent from the marketing system. This is the principal business event timestamp for the communication lifecycle.

attributes.name: subject_line
